title.romaji: Binwan Hisho ni Yuuwaku Saremashita: Hitori ja Kiss wa Dekinai

204313.description:
Wu Linggen, once the chubby kid who was constantly bullied, suddenly dies from a heart attack brought on by his weight, only to awaken in a completely different world. With a fierce determination to finally build a strong body, he quickly realizes that he’s in a realm of cultivation—where those without spiritual roots are deemed worthless. At first, he believes his newfound muscles might just help him scrape by in this bizarre land of monsters and demons. But he didn’t expect that his fists could punch through the entire world of immortal cultivation!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

204315.description:
Shuri, the ace of the popular idol group Cas/DOVE, has someone he can’t forget. It’s Mashiro Hou, who was once in the same group with Shuri, but now reigns as a solo star.

They had promised to debut together, but that dream was never realized, and Shuri can only try to chase after him — his one and only light.

Years have passed since his first love turned sour, until one day when Mashiro suddenly moves into the dorm where Cas/DOVE lives together. Their initial reunion is brief. But at night, Mashiro crawls into Shuri’s bed and sweetly seduces him.

“Hi, I’m ‘Ran,’ Mashiro’s other personality.”

With the appearance of “Ran,” a dormant love from the past begin to stir once again—!

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204317.description: Note: Published in Magazine Be x Boy December 2025 issue.

title.romaji: Tokkyuu α no Aishita Ω: Tsukasa no Henchou

204318.description:
The young man Mirza is enshrined as a "living goddess" who heals his people in the Mansion of Flowers, but in truth, he possesses no healing powers of his own. That miracle is entirely due to the divine water residing in the mountains of his homeland. One night, he saves a young foreigner struck down by a cursed poison, only for his secret to be discovered. The true identity of this young man is Asura, the "Headhunting King" of a neighboring land.

As curses and faith intertwine, the two find themselves drawn to each other, crossing boundaries of both kingdom and god. But their feelings are strictly forbidden. And so, they are swept away by the turbulent waves of destiny...

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204320.description:
We were all cute and cool, and Mao was always in the middle. Until that day, when the zombies appeared...

Led by leader Mao, the seven-member group "Mao Seven" continues to enjoy the brilliance of their youth as charismatic figures among the young. However, the sudden onset of the zombie plague has shaken the bond between the seven members...

(Source: Torch Web, translated)

title.romaji: Koyoi, Musume no Kareshi ni ni Otosaremasu

204329.description:
It's the era of 8 billion baseball players! A world where baseball is paramount! Towashima Misuta, a transfer student who suddenly appears at the Doumu Elementary School pitching club, sparks fly against a host of strong rivals! One day, the Sakaki sisters rescue a girl drowning in a river. The girl introduces herself as a goddess and says she'll grant her wish in return!? However, she can only grant one wish. There are two Sakaki sisters. A battle of popularity between the sisters begins to see which one's wish will be granted!

Bai Yu wakes up to find that he has transmigrated and become the head of the Baiyu Sect. He soon discovers that any items he gifts to his disciple will be returned to him by the system in a hundredfold, thousandfold, and even more. Sa-Ha is a sexually frustrated office worker who constantly drools over her uptight but hot boss, Isaac. When Isaac catches her napping in the supply closet, Sa-Ha tries to walk out but trips and lands right on Isaac's crotch! Both of them are mortified and agree to forget this ever happened. However, Isaac pulls Sa-Ha aside soon after and says he could hear her perverted thoughts about him since the closet incident! But instead of feeling shame, the mischievous Sa-Ha pounces on this opportunity, saying she might stop having perverted thoughts about Isaac if he just sleeps with her once...

204358.description:
Seong Ji-Hyun reunites with Baek Ian, her high school crush. Ian's competitive nature, obsessed with defeating Ji-Hyun, had strained their relationship, and she thought they'd never see each other again after graduation. But when they finally meet again, Ian approaches Ji-Hyun in a different way, becoming obsessed.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Summer, 1994. Seo-Jin is hiding from debt collectors in the middle of nowhere, facing a fate worse than bankruptcy: manual labor. When a sudden stomach ache leads to a messy disaster in a neighbor’s field, Seo-Jin is caught red-handed by the hulking owner, Cheol. Cheol helps Seo-Jin handle his spicy peppers by day, and Seo-Jin returns the favor by night. Seo-Jin thinks he’s just using the local hunk for "farm assistance," but this country boy’s heat might be too much to handle!

(Source: Lezhin US)

204360.description:
For years, Ju Seong-Min has lived in the shadow of his late father’s memory, treating the man’s legacy as his only gospel. But his isolated world is shattered when Baek Yo-Han, the stepbrother he hasn’t seen in years, suddenly reappears. But Yo-Han doesn’t come seeking a family reunion; he comes bearing ugly truths that threaten to dismantle everything Seong-Min believed about his father. As the cracks in his reality widen, Seong-Min finds himself trapped in a house with a man who hates him as much as he desires him. In this house of sins, the only thing more dangerous than the truth is the person telling it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

204366.description:
In Kabukichou, a highly addictive love drug called “Burst” is rampant—it can artificially trigger an Omega’s heat in its users. Kyouji, an elite Alpha detective leading the investigation, pays a large sum to a local influencer to chase down a lead. The person who shows up is Taiga — online streamer, former number-one host, and fellow Alpha. Kyouji had once sheltered a young Taiga and let him live with him. However, for reasons unknown, they had been out of contact for many years.

“I need you to work as my informant and help me investigate Burst.”

Taiga agrees without hesitation. Relieved, Kyouji accepts the coffee Taiga offers and takes a sip—only to be hit by an intense Omega heat!? Can Kyouji endure the relentless heat—and still catch the culprit!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Keigo is flustered by the older student in his class, but the principal asks him to help make sure Kirumi has a “fun” high school experience…

The Little Mermaid legend returns to reality! Only, it's not a mermaid princess, it's a prince!

“Is it really okay to tie you up?”

GEHEIM, the exclusive, invitation-only club, is the scene of yet another lascivious love affair again tonight. Hisaya, the dashing, princely dom; Akari, the intriguing masochist with a praise kink; Aoba, the guy with no hard limits but who suffers from erectile dysfunction… Kurou, the manager who keeps this band of colorful characters coordinated; and Shigeru, the black-suited support staff. Like their customers, they too have their own secrets and desires that are not always so clear-cut…

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

A demon as an angel's tutor?!

As punishment for a certain incident, veteran demon Mark was assigned work in the human world. Then, pure and bubbly newbie angel Ten was sent to him! Though bewildered by the order that being this angel's “tutor” was part of his job, Mark found himself unexpectedly doting on the rather unreliable Ten. Then one night, they end up having a private lesson in ‘purifying sins’ using Mark's body...?!

Naughty, sweet and spicy! The tale of an angel and a devil living together in the human world♪

But his secret is that he’s always felt a lustful desire towards his classmate Narise, who always spends his time alone in the corner of the classroom. He had intended to keep his secret fantasies about Narise’s beautiful visage to himself. However, by a stroke of chance he ends up leading a “study session” with Narise, and the distance between them rapidly shrinks. One day after school, Sugihara discovers that the innocent Narise is also harboring his own dirty secret...

Talks of buying out the company (Robotics Suit) that Dr. Yamashina and his affiliates are on the table. Kai Aito, is a young, 30-year-old management genius with assets worth 5 trillion yen. Attracted by Kai's lethal looks and abilities, Yamashina asks for his "genes" and requests a donation of his sperm or cells for research and development. The boy and the girl ponders on loneliness. Was it fate's cruel joke or mere chance that brought them together? A clumsy yet poignant youth love story emerges, depicted through the author's unique sensibility.

Everything is made up of unique vibrations. Energy and sound waves, constantly vibrating in perfect synchronicity. However, there are those that can manipulate those frequencies... capable of mass destruction and chaos. Uncover the mystery of the wave.

Ichika, who had been active as an idol, had left her group due to some reason and was trying to make a comeback in her hometown of Toyama. Then, a female ninja named Fuyou, who has traveled back in time from the Edo period, appears before her. With their own thoughts in mind, the two begin their journey as local idols. The mysterious and cute idol four-panel comic is about to begin.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

A hero emerges from childhood cruelly and incomprehensibly maimed. He travels in search of a way to heal his wound, inflicted by his own father. The father intended thereby to seal a sinister pact with dark forces, which would ever after lie in wait along the son's path. The hero rides astride a trustworthy and magical mount and provides from the aid of a god.

Cherry Blossom Empire, known among players as "the weak princess game," is a game with the objective of keeping Princess Tatiana alive until her 18th birthday. That's easier said than done since Tatiana dies just from eating cake! So when an avid gamer who's finally cleared this frustrating game is reborn into it as Tatiana, she has to do it all over again, starting as a baby... But with a potential death ending lurking at every corner, will Tatiana's gaming skills be enough for her to survive?

The story follows the protagonist, who is reincarnated as Liliana, a character from a girls' game he created. Liliana is a villainous young lady, and as her favorability rating with the heroine increases in the game, she dies in an accident or from illness, earning her the nickname "hard mode young lady." Kyoko moves into a cheap apartment, only to find that it is haunted by the ghost of a British gentleman named Ambrose. Attracted by his housekeeping skills and appearance, she begins living with him in a strange but fun cohabitation. However, she soon discovers that his inability to rest in peace will have a significant impact on Kyoko... A wide-format, four-panel home comedy set in the Reiwa era.

If you put it in, you break up... that's our secret rule.

Orie, a reliable girl with strong self-control, has recently broken up with her cheating fiancé. Disappointed in men, she was talking to a colleague at work about how "if I'm going to date, it should be someone who is honest and doesn't mind not having sex," when her younger, doggy-like junior colleague, Kazuki, sincerely confessed that he didn't mind not having sex, and they started dating. However, when Kazuki asked Orie if it was okay for her to only give pleasure to Orie, Orie realized that in the end, he just wanted to have sex. Confident in her ability to control her sexual desires, Orie decided to tease him by setting the condition, "You can do whatever you want, but if you put it in, we'll break up," but...?

An illegitimate daughter lies about her identity to marry a captain in a strategic marriage, but she's doted on and showered in his love...

"I'm upset because your wet hair is so captivating." It is the Taisho era and Kaede, who was treated as a maid even though she comes from a good family, is married off to Yukisada, a military captain from a noble family, to save her family's business. However, she must lie about her identity to marry him as a "proper" young lady. Her true identity must absolutely not be revealed. Her married life begins with secrets. Although she feels guilty, Kaede begins to fall for Yukisada, who dotes on her and is overprotective.

The legend of the assassin has returned!

Don't you dare speak of "the strongest" in my presence. I will show you why the heavens are higher than Mount Tai. The great realm of true and evil unification that all martial artists dream of! Behold the birth of a true master who has unified the path and the path of magic, something no one in the millennia of martial arts has ever achieved!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

You survived. Yes, you survived. Are you going to try again? You will. This time, you might actually die. He said that those who have faced death many times are truly strong, and that they will eventually become the greatest warrior in the world. Yes! Fighting is ultimately about killing and dying. Those who have learned the most in the face of death will ultimately become the best.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Ja-Un’s forced by his abusive family to take his cousin’s place as a ritual sacrifice meant to end the plague. On the way to his death, Ja-Un recalls the only friend he had as a child—a little snake named Sosa. When he calls its name, the demi-god Sosa, who has loved Ja-Un through all his lifetimes, appears and spirits him to safety. Despite Sosa’s affection, Ja-Un’s trauma and the torment carried from his past lives linger, and not even Sosa may have the power to protect what he cherishes most.

(Source: Tapas)

She arrives like spring--soft, unassuming, yet impossible to ignore--carrying scars that glow like dim embers. Yet her presence begins to thaw a man who buried his heart in ice long ago. Beneath a canopy of stars, over a sea of petals, love flickers… fragile, defiant, and dangerously pure.

(Source: WEBTOON)

204434.description:
After a series of unexplained deaths marked by a cryptic symbol, three individuals find themselves entangled in a mysterious phenomenon with no known origin. What begins as a source of unexpected fortune soon grants them everything they once desired--love, opportunity, and control. But the gift comes at a cost. As strange instructions appear and reality begins to fracture, they realize the force behind it is quietly taking over their lives… and their survival. Beneath its guise of luck lies something far more dangerous. The question is: can they recognize misfortune before it’s too late?

(Source: WEBTOON)

204435.description:
Only a swordmaster can slay another. Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him. In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within. With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance. To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ซอร์ดมาสเตอร์ผู้กลืนดาบ

204437.description:
It's got a strong smell, some nicotine, and no isopropyl alcohol. But you can take a breather in this semi-basement cafe. It's a hotbed of true feelings. A wife troubled by her abusive husband, a gal who doesn't belong at school, a newly divorced editor... This cafe is naturally supportive of its customers who are living stressful days, and sometimes even intervenes with force. The cafe is run by Fujiko, the owner with her grey hair and a secret; Etsuko, the baby-faced waitress; and Kamuzo, the plump mascot dog. This is a refreshing comedy about women who can't wait and cut through the "tiresome everyday life."

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ホーム・スイート・ホーム

204440.description:
Nanjo Yuto (27), a professional gamer. This is the passionate and earnest story of a man who puts everything into team-based battle royale games. FPS is rage!!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

204441.description:
The idol I'd dedicated 10 years of my life to as a fan retired. I was in despair, but the next thing I knew, I was a second-year high school student... I had to relive my youth in order to meet my first love again!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

204442.description:
A 26-year-old salesman selling green juice. A 66-year-old veteran bluesman. Their lives have been swapped!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ブルーブルーそしてブルース

204446.description:
Haruto had been eagerly awaiting his summer vacation reunion with his beloved big brother, only to be devastated when his mother told him the visit was canceled. But then... there he was! His brother, the one he'd been waiting for all along! The two enjoy their summer to the fullest with bug catching, soccer, and fireworks, but then...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

204447.description:
This is a youthful boxing drama about two young men who meet in a juvenile detention center and aim to break down -- mow down the roughnecks and change their lives with just their fists!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: BLUE FIGHT～蒼き若者たちのブレイキングダウン～
title.romaji: Blue Fight: Aoki Wakamono-tachi no Breaking Down

204448.description:
The legendary master thief is supposed to be a criminal of the century, but he turns into a child and becomes part of a police family?! Master Thief Lupin always manages to slip through the police's cordon and steal valuable jewels. It should have been easy as usual. However, that day, immediately after stealing the jewels, he was shot by someone, and when he came to, he had transformed into a child! And unfortunately, the family that took in the child Lupin was the very police family that had always been chasing him! He can't escape from this eccentric family, no matter how hard he tries! If his true identity is revealed, he'll be arrested immediately! A thrilling master thief action story begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: もふもふと楽しむ無人島のんびり開拓ライフ ～VRMMOでぼっちを満喫するはずが、全プレイヤーに注目されているみたいです～
title.romaji: Mofumofu to Tanoshimu Mujintou Nonbiri Kaitaku Life: VRMMO de Bocchi wo Mankitsu Suru Hazu ga, Zen Player ni Chuumoku Sareteiru Mitai desu

204450.description:
Fighting with a sword held between your buttocks... that's what a Ketsu Battler does!

(Source: CoroCoro)

A tie-in to the Switch game of the same name.

title.native: シンカリオン チェンジ ザ ワールド
重いタバコを吸ってる不健康そうな年上美人とドロドロの関係になっていた話
title.romaji: Omoi Tabaco wo Sutteru Fukenkousou na Toshiue Bijin to Dorodoro no Kankei ni Natteita Hanashi

204455.description: Tamako Kawashima, a member of her school’s track and field club, is a regular competitor at the national inter-high championships in pole vaulting. One rainy day during the summer holidays, following a certain incident, she resolves to search for a way to bring her deceased teacher back to life. She embarks on this journey alongside her childhood friend, Minato Takahama, and three other students who bear mysterious burn marks.

title.native: まなざし珠子の自由研究

204456.description:
Lee Jae-Ha knows it’s absurd for him to ask for Jang Tae-Geon’s hand in marriage. While Jae-Ha is the heir to Korea’s most prestigious corporation, Tae-Geon is a violent gangster. But above all, both of them are dominant alphas. So when they inevitably do get married, Jae-Ha doesn’t dare to ask for anything more, instead drawing lines in the name of respecting the man he selfishly fell in love with. But these lines only end up aggravating Tae-Geon, who’s actually had his eyes on Jae-Ha just the same...

(Source: Tappytoon)

204457.description:
Five years ago, Winston and Yu-Jin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yu-Jin’s was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine… But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 男風呂チャレンジ…失敗!サウナで囲まれ…
title.romaji: Otokoburo Challenge... Shippai! Sauna de Kakomare...

204459.description:
In a school filled with humanoid creatures of all kinds, one cowgirl is at the top of the high school hierarchy. Tall and beautiful Ushiyama has got it all: looks, smarts, and serious volleyball skills. She’s beloved by all at school, but especially by one shy and small-statured batboy. Will someone like Ushiyama ever give him the time of day or is it better to admire her from afar?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: オトコノコとの甘い体験×5

204464.description:
Kim Seo-Jun, a former high school teacher. Having tasted life's bitterness through stocks and cryptocurrency, Kim Seo-Jun discovers countless gold coins during a school trip. But the moment he picks them up, he is cursed and falls into a martial arts world. Kim Seo-Jun, who wants to live well in the martial arts world with enough gold coins to last a lifetime, and the System that wants to exploit him any way it can. And then there's the ‘modern figure’ who arrived in the martial arts world before Kim Seo-Jun. Now begins Kim Seo-Jun's epic martial arts saga, complete with skulls.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 人生こじらせて武侠世界に来ました

204465.description:
The protagonist, wandering the martial arts world carrying the secret of the red dot, enters Gaebong through a chance encounter with a legendary figure. His master, who had taught him absolute martial arts, dies mysteriously. With the death of his mentor, a pillar of the Gaebong faction, the Gaebong faction gradually declines. The protagonist decides to leave Gaebong to investigate his master's death and create a new Gaebong that will not be ignored.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204467.description:
By day, Felix Sheng is an elite CEO, but by night, he secretly moonlights as a thirst streamer... One day, a handsome, carefree rich kid landed at the company to be his assistant, he had no choice but to put up with him while carefully guarding his own secret identity. However, this seemingly innocent rich kid was hiding a secret even crazier than his own. In this game of “who’ll slip up first,” Felix discovered that he was the one who had fallen into the trap.

(Source: WebComics)

204468.description:
As an impaired Omega, Yin Ran had assumed he’d live out his remaining years in peace. Unfortunately, he was suddenly kidnapped one day... and the abductors turned out to be his underclassmen from high school! Beside being shocked, his dormant scent gland — which was damaged and numbed for years — was stimulated under the double-dose of pheromones, reawakening his long-slumbering heat cycle…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

204478.description:
After careful consideration and meticulous planning, Kashimiya Tsukasa ends his life to save his family. However, instead of reaching the afterlife, his eyes snap open to scenes of torture, mutilation, and so much pain…all inflicted by his own hands. When his head clears, he realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the world of his favorite novel—not as a hero, but as the sadistic Duke Heinreid von Rodvelia. Haunted by the memories of the duke’s vile deeds, he vows to atone by giving himself the permanent ending he deserves. But soon, his shift in personality arouses the suspicions of Craig Bauer, Heinreid’s personal knight and the one who finally kills him in the original novel. Craig’s attention slips into obsession, and as his fate intertwines with Heinreid’s doomed destiny, the story of the novel begins to warp around them. Will Heinreid end up skewered down to the hilt of Craig’s sword? Or can even the most despicable duke find a reason to keep living beyond the final page?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Despicable Duke Settles His Affairs

204480.description: A year after the final battle, the four girls, Mana, Rikka, Makoto, and Alice had fully returned to their normal lives. Regina, who had entered the same junior high school as Mana and Rikka, is just as boisterous as ever, but Aguri also enjoys spending time with them, making for peaceful days. Then one day, the Jikochuu, who were supposed to be left behind in that decisive battle, suddenly appear again....! The final summer of junior high for Mana and her friends features another decisive battle. The heart-pounding has yet to stop!

title.native: 小説　ドキドキ！プリキュア

204483.description:
Moon Oh-hoon, a rookie killer, enters the world of killers, a world steeped in blood and gunpowder. But amidst a life that's strangely different from what he expected, Oh-hoon strives to become the ultimate killer. The daily lives of killers are enjoyable, if not mind-numbing!

(Source: Naver, translated)

204485.description:
At 32, Yuna has been dumped by her boyfriend. With the breakup with her boyfriend, who gave her so many memories, still fresh her life seems bleak. Fed up, she decides to play around with men, Yuna meets Ren, a handsome younger man. Instead of being thrilled by Ren's cheerful and considerate nature, Yuna becomes increasingly self-deprecating. But when Ren hears about Yuna's heartbreak, he looks her straight in the eyes and says, "I'll make you forget that guy." Is this a chance for Yuna to finally play the bad girl?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: I Failed at Love, so I'm Ready to Be a Slut!
title.native: 恋が下手でもあばずれたい。

204486.description:
Marcy is the leader of a group working against a major company's redevelopment plans for a struggling city. Specifically, she's up against Randal, the company's negotiator. Marcy's aunt left her a house in the middle of the city. When she makes it known that she won't give in no matter how many threats or how much money they throw at her, the company schemes to send in a handsome man to seal the deal. Initially Marcy laughs at their simplistic approach. In time, however, she finds herself being swayed by Randal's sexy, grandiose seduction as well as a surprising secret...

(Source: Renta!)

204487.description:
Polly goes to the desert kingdom of Dharia to look for her father. However, in the airport, she's summarily seized and taken to the palace. There she meets the handsome King Rashad. His sharp eyes and dignified stature make Polly's heart race. Then, while she's staying at the palace, he suddenly proposes. Polly, whose heart has been captured by him, agrees to marry, but their relationship is merely a practical affair. To Rashad, the marriage fulfills a royal duty. Still, Polly believes that one day her love will reach him...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 三姉妹はシンデレラ Ⅰ

204488.description:
The Belair family's acting skills are famous worldwide, but Lucilla Belair has a problem. She thought it would only be natural for her to pick a career in acting, since she grew up in Hollywood, but she's lost one audition after another. Panicking, she decides she'll go to any length to get the role of her dreams, so she breaks into the hotel room of a famous director! But the man she meets there isn't the director at all...Lucilla wants to run away, but she's too intrigued by this stranger. It's as if he can see right through her...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 大富豪と手折られた花

204489.description:
Goh Hae-ju was a perfectly ordinary twenty-year-old, possessing perhaps just a little more curiosity than the average girl her age. However, upon entering university, she falls in with a crowd of wild, deeply promiscuous friends. Growing up, the elders always warned her about the vital importance of choosing her companions wisely. As it turns out, that old advice was entirely right—from the moment she joins their circle, Hae-ju’s life spirals in a completely unprecedented direction. Her descent begins disastrously when she loses her virginity to none other than her own friend's boyfriend. Initially, Hae-ju finds herself helplessly strung along, a mere pawn in their chaotic games. Yet, as she navigates this messy web of betrayal, she begins to adapt. She learns exactly how to manipulate men, slowly unlocking and embracing her own raw, untamed desires. Now, completely hooked on the thrill of making men beg for her attention, Hae-ju proudly and fully embraces a life of unapologetic deviance.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In 2087, two disasters have shattered the established order on Earth. Tae-O, a janitor, lives on a small island formed from the sinking of a large city. One day, a mysterious intruder crash-lands, forcing him to team up with Ya-Na, his arch-enemy of ten years. Overnight, a camaraderie blossoms between Tae-O and Ya-Na, and they become increasingly embroiled in a series of incidents...

(Source: Naver, translated)

204502.description:
Nam Yeon-Seo, the goddess of the prestigious Cheonghan University. Pretty and adorable, Yeon-Seo is a kind and lovable con artist, and every boy in school adores her. But one day, when a strange man starts hanging around Yeon-Seo, her best friend Hwang Seon-Mi grows anxious.

"You two must never meet! That man is too good for Yeon-Seo to date... There's no other reason!!!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

204503.description:
32 years after moving to Tokyo at 18, 50-year-old Youko has decided to quit her job as an "unsuccessful actor" and return to her hometown of Fukuoka. No money. No stamina. No perseverance. She faces the reality of being "50 and unemployed." Amidst all this, Youko's "new life" begins when she meets her landlord's affable son, Kaisei, and her part-time coworkers.

Quitting her job. Leaving Tokyo. Giving up on something. This is the story of how someone who never achieved anything discovers a new self.

(Source: Ohta Shuppan, translated)

204504.description:
Ever since losing her parents at a young age, Celeste Golding endured abuse from her uncle's family while bravely pursuing her path as a Celestial Beast Master. But when she's wrongfully sentenced to death for allegedly controlling her Celestial Beast, she mysteriously finds herself back in her childhood! A tale of a girl who lost everything, fighting to reclaim her "life"... An Isekai story of the second chance!

(Source: emaqi)

title.english: The Fake Marriage of a Noblewoman: A Second Life With a Military General and Cuddly Celestial Beasts
title.native: 死に戻り令嬢の仮初め結婚　～二度目の人生は生真面目将軍と星獣もふもふ～

204507.description:
“What did I deliver?!”

To escape the hardships of life, he takes on a high-paying delivery job, but gets caught up in an unmanageable incident and meets retired legendary biker gang members.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204511.description:

- Chapters 6 to 15 were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes three extra chapters.

204512.description:
Kang Jihyuk was the eldest grandson of Taesung, South Korea’s largest conglomerate. He should have inherited everything Taesung had to offer, but due to someone’s conspiracy, he lost his parents and was abandoned in an orphanage. 20 years later, he returns to Taesung under the name 'Seo Jihyuk'... and his revenge begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204513.description:
Ogino lives by the motto "slow and steady wins the race," but his methodical life is put to the test when he's tasked with training the department's newest transfer, Toraya. Will this boss-employee pair be thrown off balance by Toraya's chaotic way of thinking?!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.romaji: Aki no Kemono to Kiss no Mure

204514.description:
Brilliant, blunt, and determined to keep everyone at a distance, Irene Rios is a medical prodigy with an intense fear of being touched. Diego Cassis, the charming Grand Duke of Divoa, has long since grown bored with the world around him. But when he meets Irene, a woman utterly unimpressed by his title or charms, his interest is finally piqued. He needs her skills. She wants him to leave her alone. But as fascination draws these opposites closer, they may find themselves changing each other in ways neither expected.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ถอยไปอย่าใกล้เกิน

title.native: 可愛いなんて言わないで。

204518.description:
Makoto, an ex-yakuza, has harbored feelings for his best friend Ayato since high school but has always been afraid to confess his love and risk ruining their friendship. Instead, he resigns himself to the role of best friend to the bitter end...that is, until Ayato tells him he's dating—a guy. Makoto does a total 180 and vows to win over Ayato's heart by any means necessary—after all, he thinks, "I loved him first!"

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204529.description:
Proposing during the live broadcast...? That wasn't part of the script! Kaho, an average office worker, is desperate to save her family's restaurant from closing, and successfully auditions for a popular reality dating show where the winning couple receives ten million yen. After an unexpected coincidence, she finds an unlikely co-conspirator in her fellow contestant Akito, an entrepreneur. During the final episode, they announce their intentions to stay together on camera to close out the season like they'd planned, but everyone's surprised when Akito suddenly proposes to Kaho! It certainly makes for good TV, but Akito then tells her after the cameras are off that he wasn't kidding! What exactly is he thinking?! This was all supposed to be fake, so why is he acting so sweet to her now?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Proposing Wasn't Part of the Script!
title.native: この求婚は台本にありません！
title.romaji: Kono Kyuukon wa Daihon ni Arimasen!

204531.description:
Married men, liars, moral harassers… It's time to punish these vile marriage-hunting monsters! A thrilling romantic comedy about a pair of beautiful marriage-hunting childhood friends who hold grand secrets begins now!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 36 episodes and 12 chapters respectively.

title.native: 華麗なる婚活バスターズ

204532.description:
Killed after a betrayal, S-rank awakened Lee Jiye is reincarnated as Cyrillia, the villainous younger sister in “Revenge of Alexis,” a novel about the tragic bond between the two sisters of House Parkision. Destined to die by Alexis’ vengeful hand, the new Cyrillia must work to win her sister over while dangerous plots, hidden spies, and power struggles close in around their family. But when the story no longer follows the novel she remembers, can she still avoid the fate that awaits her?

(Source: Tapas)

How To Survive As The Villainous Younger Sister

あのこのスカートのなか

title.native: 逢田さん、俺たちセフレでいいの？
title.romaji: Aida-san, Oretachi Sefure de Ii no?

204538.description:
"What do you mean 'go to college and you'll finally get a girlfriend'?!"

After gathering every ounce of courage to confess his love at the freshman retreat, he ended up getting slapped hard right in front of the entire student body. Desperate and utterly humiliated, his final wish was simple: Man, I just want to be born again! A freak accident suddenly swaps his soul with the school's most popular, effortlessly handsome guy on campus. The wildest part? He doesn't even have to lift a finger, yet classmates, underclassmen, and even a female professor are suddenly throwing themselves at him. Is dating seriously this easy? Damn you, lookism...! But hey, if life hands you a cheat code, you use it. Heheh... hahahahaha! He is about to fully enjoy every single perk of this gorgeous new face.

(Source: Lezhin US)

204546.description:
Toshun was born with a spirit's heart inside his body. This overwhelming power was too strong for his mortal frame to contain, and thus shortened his lifespan. Already steps away from death's door, he heads out into the mountains to return the heart to its rightful owner. Once there, he meets a beautiful spirit named Chofu, who tells him that centuries ago, Toshun's ancestor was the one who stole his heart. To help make amends, Toshun agrees to enter into Chofu's service. But, on the night of the full moon, a sweet scent lures him to the most enticing scene...

(Source: Animate International)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204548.description:
Princess Layla of the desert country Ishra has drawn the incredibly talented Australian lawyer Mikael into her secret plan. Thanks to her overprotective father, she's never left her country, even though she's twenty-four! Layla has also been ordered to marry a man she hates before she's ever experienced real love. She wants to live her life on her own terms at least once, so she accompanies her older brother on his honeymoon. Once she's away from home, she sneaks off to spend a week with Mikael, free of all obligations, but it seems there was one factor she hadn't accounted for...

(Source: Renta!)

synonyms: The Marriage Contract Will Be Signed in a Suite

title.native: 夫婦契約はスイートルームで～ムカつく御曹司と蜜月ホテル経営
title.romaji: Fuufu Keiyaku wa Suite Room de: Mukatsuku Onzoushi to Mitsugetsu Hotel Keiei

204550.description:
Set in the futuristic world, humans are facing a crisis like never before as immortal cultivators continue to invade their homes. Teenager Wu Ran, notoriously known as a loser, almost loses his life while trying to save his goddess. Through that near-death experience, he awakens a strange die system by chance. But the catch is, every skill he acquires solely depends on luck. Watch how an underdog finally turns his life around and rises to the top.

(Source: WebComics)

204552.description:
Rio and Yakumo are members of the idol group KEy, formed through an audition program. One day, while wishing to become closer to the cool Yakumo, an unexpected kiss completely changes their relationship! It turns out Yakumo was actually a super-devoted fan, absolutely obsessed and in love with Rio! Since confessing his feelings, Yakumo's romantic and lustful desires have only escalated. Seeing the special side he only shows him, Rio begins to waver between friendship and love...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: No Kisses, No Love, Yet We Fell Anyway.

title.native: キスとか恋とか、NGなのに
title.romaji: Kiss toka Koi toka, NG nano ni

204553.hashtag: #栗山先生には鳴海くんがまぶしすぎる

title.native: 栗山先生には鳴海くんがまぶしすぎる！
title.romaji: Kuriyama-sensei ni wa Narumi-kun ga Mabushi Sugiru!

204554.description:
Lev lives peacefully in solitude with his robot, Meer. In addition to his work, he spends his days thinking about how to bring Meer closer to his "ideal" robot. However, on one stormy night, an incident caused Meer to change...

(Source: Homesha, translated)

204555.description:
“Dad loves someone. Someone who isn't you, mom.”

After hearing her daughter's shocking words, a battle with her husband begin! Kasumi married Yosuke, whom she admired since her school days.

However, she finds it difficult to get along with Masaya and Emi, who are Yosuke's friends. Ever since Masaya moved to Tokyo on a job away from home, Emi, who has come to visit frequently, seems to be closer to Yosuke...? When Kasumi finally decides to divorce Yosuke, he takes an overbearing attitude toward their daughter...!

title.native: パパ、浮気してるよ？娘と二人でクズ夫を捨てます
title.romaji: Papa, Uwaki shiteru yo? Musume to Futari de Kuzu Otto wo Sutemasu

synonyms: クイーン・ダブルサーティーン－

204557.description: This mom with the heart of a teenager (who is actually 42 years old!!) is in the prime of her youth! Supported by her responsible daughter and attentive husband (!?), she is very busy chasing after boys and flirting with them! Come and rejuvenate yourself with her!

title.native: プリティ・ママがライバル!

204558.description:
Hirasawa Mito was supposed to be celebrating a happy birthday with his parents, but he loses his dreams and his family in a traffic accident. He is then told that the "home" he lived in with his family will become a shared house where criminals gather...!? Victim and perpetrator. When "one" who has lost their place in society gathers together, time that had stopped begins to move again. A home-based drama of loss and rebirth.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

204562.description:
When the manger brought in a dusty-looking board game, no one knew that... this is one game you can't escape.

(Source: Toomics)
synonyms: アスモデック～快楽ボードゲーム～

204563.description:
Ookami-san has arrived at school.
Himura Akane, a sophomore and member of the discipline committee, is very studious, but also sincere, petite, and adorable, making her beloved by everyone at school and very popular.

One day, the principal asks her to be the tutor in charge of the education of Ookami Ren, the daughter of the board chairman. Since Akane's goal is to enter college on a scholarship, she decides to accept the assignment.

However, Ren turns out to be much bigger than her physically and, on top of that, a troublesome girl with a cunning mind full of bad ideas...?!

A girls' comedy starring a small and adorable senpai and a big and difficult-to-handle kouhai begins!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: Does Anybody Here Know How to Tame a Wolf?!

title.native: 誰かオオカミさんのしつけ方知りませんか！？
title.romaji: Dare ka Ookami-san no Shitsukekata Shirimasen ka!?

204565.description:
A massive war erupts between angels and aliens, with the very fabric of the afterlife at stake. Kim Ria, the last surviving human on Earth who has no lingering attachment to life, and Azazel, an angel who despises the god exiled from the afterlife, become the pivots upon which the fate of both humanity and the afterlife turns. In the afterlife, angels and aliens clash into an all‑out war. At the same time, on Earth, Azazel and Kim Ria undertake a tense survival adventure as they evade pursuit squads hunting the final human.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204566.description: The most erotic story in someone's life is sure to be entertaining. Enmaru, the 14th King of Enma, listens to the erotic stories that the dead took to their graves today, or "hakabanashi" for short, and decides where they will be reincarnated. Will they be reborn as humans again, or... The fate of Hell also depends on the story. A final judgment omnibus drawn by the genius of modern comedy manga, Hara Katsunori!

204567.description:
He wanted to become a Knight, yet awakened with the vocation of a "Merchant"?! Young Merchant Oz made a promise with the God of Commerce, Mercury, who had lost her memories. Before Oz helps the Goddess return to the realm of gods once again, he would attain the ability of 100% forced transaction — 【The Merchant God's Scale】, as well as the use of money as weapons to fight against the great number of incoming enemies. What is the truth hidden in the fog? What direction will the tracks of fate continue in? "This time, I want to protect all of you!" The commerce-themed harem romance adventure drama begins now!!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: The Merchant Vocation's Law of Combat
title.native: 商业系天职的战斗法则
title.romaji: Shangye Xi Tianzhi De Zhandou Faze

204568.description:
I'm supposed to hate younger men, but before you know it, our lips are getting closer... I think I'm about to break the "no romance under the same roof" rule...!

(Source: Renta!)

204569.description:
"How long can a human being keep their senses after consummating with the God of Lovemaking?"

Saint Roya only wants one thing in life: to lose her virginity. Unfortunately, as the Saint of Fertility... that wish is off the table. Or is it? When she summons the God of Fertility, but the God of Lovemaking shows up instead, will she give in to her temptations...? Even if her choice puts the country in danger?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Losing My Virginity to the God of Love
title.native: 神様とハジメテ。～誤召喚した神に寵愛されました
title.romaji: Kamisama to Hajimete.: Goshoukan shita Kami ni Chouai Saremashita

204571.description:
"Would you like to change the world even if it meant destroying everything?"

One day, Komori Neito, a young NEET, discovers a strange website. It is a recruitment advertisement for Metallica, a global evil organization. The time is the 22nd century. Neito finds himself facing off against the hero of justice, the Silver Knight Dylan. Together with his boss, a girl from his same year, and a rival, he begins his fight to change the world within this unreasonable organization! This is the story of a rebellious young man who follows his own beliefs and ideals.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.romaji: Aku no Soshiki no Kyuujin Koukoku

204572.description:
"We don't need bad people," the woman says as she approaches. "Boogie Girl" is an urban legend that is said to appear if you do something bad. What is the reason that Boogie Girl appears...? A terrifying horror!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204573.description:
As a military commander, I accidentally crossed over into another world due to a car accident. After opening my eyes, I found out that I had become the only waste princess in this world who had no spiritual power. To that, I just wanted to say, "You messed with the wrong person!" I got the system and awakened the top spiritual power in no time! I fought the enemy with a bazooka and turned the world upside down! The only problem is that there are too many people who like me, like can you line up and wait for your turn, huh?

(Source: WebComics)

204574.description:
A wealthy vice president of an entertainment company is accused of violating a "moral code of conduct for women" and is sent back in time to inhabit a singer's body who is destined to die in a year. She must follow the code of conduct, but begins to suspect that the singer's death might have been more than just an unfortunate incident.

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: How About Ten Thousand Folds of Scheming?

204575.description:
One minute, she's inheriting a fortune; the next, she's trapped in a twisted rich family drama. And not as a darling, either. She's the villainess who just framed the heroine and turned the story's big bad into her personal blood bank. Basically, she's ticked off everyone. To survive this mess, she's gotta pull a complete 180, win over the heroine, and grovel to the villain. Watch as she goes from scheming brat to devoted little sister, all while trying to avoid a very messy end.

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: Transmigrated as the Masked Boss's Sister
Transmigrating as the Younger Sister of a Bigshot With Multiple Identities
ぶりっ子妹として好感度を挽回します

When Akio was in elementary school, he built a 'temple' like he was making a secret base. Now in high school, Akio casually stops by the 'temple' he had long forgotten one day, and there he finds a mysterious boy praying fervently... With no place to belong at school or home, the boys continue to wander the area, eventually throwing themselves into a vortex of sex and desire...

(Source: Yosumi, translated)

204586.description:
“Don’t you think we’re missing that heart-fluttering feeling?”

From elementary school all the way to high school, Nam Do-yeon and Jeong A-rin have gone from childhood friends to lovers. For a couple who strives for a perfectly rational relationship, a plan to reclaim that one missing piece of excitement. Operation: Heartbeat begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

204587.description:
After five years of devotion, Yu-Ju Han was dumped by her boyfriend for her best friend. With nowhere to vent her rage, she crosses paths with Tae-i Go, the nation's hottest and most controversial superstar. He’s wealthy, breathtaking… and terminally ill. When a fake dating scandal between the two sets the internet ablaze, Tae-i offers Yu-Ju a "golden ticket": a chance to turn her life into a masterpiece of revenge. The price? Just a little bit of love. Will Yu-Ju remain a victim, or will she finally get greedy?

(Source: WEBTOON)

204588.description:
"You'd better apologize before I sue you for sexual harassment."

Matthew has always worked harder than anyone else at his company, where most of the employees are women. Despite that, all he received from his coworkers was derision and ridicule. One day, after suffering humiliation from his female coworkers, he decides to seize an investment opportunity that comes his way, kick- starting a new and exciting chapter of his life.

(Source: TOPTOON)
synonyms: マネーゲーム～返済はカラダで～

204589.description:
Evie Alden wasn't supposed to be here. A girl from the poorhouse, she was admitted to the elite Imperial Gifted Center on a whim—hand-selected by a lonely emperor despite her humble beginnings. Now an outsider, Evie faces ruthless bullying from peers who want her gone. But she has a secret weapon... a genius so undeniable that even the most feared instructors can’t ignore it. As Evie proves she belongs, she unknowingly begins to heal the broken heart of the man who thought he’d lost everything.

(Source: Tapas)

204609.description:
A brilliant surgeon meets a tragic end during an earthquake while operating on his only sibling. Reborn into a mysterious otherworld as a deadly assassin, he must reconcile his past vocation with a new, morally fraught existence as a “revenger.” Just as he contemplates his shattered identity, a girl who mirrors his sister appears before him --–an uncanny echo that pulls him into a labyrinth of fate, duty, and supernatural suspense.

(Source: Titan Manga)

204610.description:
Elvir is a princess born to the king of the volcanic nation of Fastu and her wildcat-beast mother. Although she was born out of wedlock, she was given the status of princess as an exception, and was to marry Arnold II, the king of the great nation of Zugvogel. However, he was known as the "cursed king." What's more, her half-sister, Ruby, who had always harassed her, was to accompany her to the wedding as a maid!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 隣国に輿入れした王女付きモフモフ侍女ですが、本当の王女は私なんです～立場と声を奪われましたが、命の危機に晒されているので傍観します～

204611.description:
I got hit by a truck one day and reincarnated into a fantasy adventure world. This isn't quite your usual tale of swords and sorcery, though—gender roles in this world are the opposite of Earth's, and all the adventurers around me are huge, buff women! Luckily, I've met a pair of friendly veteran swordswomen who are really eager to take an inexperienced male adventurer like me under their wing...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

204612.description:
Abby has lost her self-confidence and her courage. After being fired from her job, she felt like all her hard work was for nothing, so a heartbroken Abby ran off by herself to Lake Tahoe. Just when she had decided to pursue a more relaxing life, her car gets a flat tire in the middle of the night on a snow-covered road and she's stranded. It's the worst day of her life. As she holds back her tears, a hero appears in front of her. Gar, the muscular and handsome owner of a ski lodge, gives her a moment of peace. She imagined that would be the last she saw of him, but the future has something else in store for Abby!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 二百パーセント愛してる

204614.description:
Mirai Todoroki, a freshman at Arashino Girls' High School, is petite but has a deep passion for table tennis. She once had the skill to compete at the national level, but after suffering a crushing defeat against a player with overwhelming talent during her middle school years, she gave up the sport. Then one day, a transfer student named Oka Harusaki joins the table tennis club...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

204631.description: After an explosive increase in world population and the depletion of world resources, the lifespan of all humans is now limited to 75 years. When Zhang Yi, a high school student known as the most evil existence in his school, tries to help his grandfather avoid the mandatory death, he discovers something by accident — the purpose of the mandatory death law is to cover up a secret that mankind cannot bear to know. From then on, all kinds of things and people that he has never heard of keep getting drawn into his life. The truth of the world is gradually revealing itself to him!
synonyms: Path to the Underworld Is Concealed
Road to the Yellow Springs Is Hidden

204634.description:
A flashy action-packed story about a middle school bodyguard who goes undefeated against a hitman! The main character, Shion Hiiraki, is a bodyguard with overwhelming fighting abilities despite being a middle school student. While hiding his true identity from those around him, he must protect the middle school student company president, Emi Zaiin, whose life is constantly being targeted by a hitman.

(Source: Corocoro, translated)

204635.description:
A girl and her mysterious companion embark on a journey in her grandfather's classic car. The girl has a reason for traveling and a hometown she needs to change. Aiko Koyama weaves together a gentle and heartwarming tapestry of life's moments. The story of "I'm home" and "Welcome back" begins now.

(Source: Shogakukan)

204636.description:
Illustrator Mitsuko Aikawa (nicknamed Pikako) lives with her husband Haruo. They are happy every day, but when they live together, things start to bother them. How to wash the dishes, how to vacuum, how to take on conversations... There are a few rules in the Aikawa household. So that they can live peacefully. So that their partner can live happily. Over dinner, they always find the distance between them just right. Meals, conversations, and consideration in the Aikawa household ♪

(Source: Coamix, translated)

204637.description:
Toraya Totaro, an unsuccessful comedian whose partner has become a hit, loses his girlfriend and his home at the same time, and on that day, he meets a mysterious woman named Tayuta, who speaks to him in a friendly manner. When he comes into contact with her and her beloved tanka poetry, Totaro's fate begins to change! A tanka comedy in which a 31-character "spell" changes the world!

204638.description:
After failing to reincarnate countless times, Tao Zhi, a young girl, finally found a way she might enter reincarnation: to help a human teenager, Gui Zizhuo, who collaborates with the Ghost Realm, to raise the ratings of his ghost exorcisms. That being said, could Gui Zizhuo, whose exorcism methods were oversimplified and crude, get any good reviews?! Tao Zhi was once again deeply concerned about her chances at reincarnation...

(Source: Coolmic)

66 million years ago, a martial arts world where dinosaurs wield martial arts. Amidst the chaos following the Heavenly Demon's Rebellion, the young Triceratops boy Byeokroea, having lost his master, embarks on an adventure to uncover hidden martial arts and the truth about the Heavenly Demon. Facing a colossal conspiracy and the secret of a great catastrophe, he becomes the last hope of the dinosaur martial arts world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204647.description:
Star doctor Soh Baek-gil is the perfect Alpha, but only on paper. In reality, he’s pheromone-blind and incapable of arousal. When he meets Kim Rohee, an Omega nurse with a massive complex about her own overwhelming scent, he thinks he’s found the perfect research subject. He expected a data sample, he didn't expect to lose his mind.

(Source: Lezhin US)

204648.description:
The popular and affectionate Myeong Jae-Yun. Yu Hae-Su, who has long harbored a secret crush on him, one day dreams an erotic dream featuring him. Fearing that if things continue this way, he might one day pounce on Jae-Yun, his childhood friend, and ruin their friendship, Hae-Su resolves to distance himself from Myeong Jae-Yun. Instead, to soothe his overflowing feelings and sexual desire, he buys adult toys. But on Christmas Eve, just as he was about to spend it alone with her dildo, Myeong Jae-Yun catches him red-handed, about to use the adult toy. Just when he thought everything was ruined, a miracle happened. A strange object appeared before Hae-Su's eyes. A Santa's Wish Contract document! Wait, does this mean her constant wish for ‘Myeong Jae-Yun’ is actually going to be granted?! And Santa really did exist! Realizing Myeong Jae-Yoon would now move only as he commanded, Yu Hae-Su's first order was...

“I want to have sex with you. Is that okay?”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

204651.description:
If the villain gets killed by the bandit, then the happy ending will be achieved! Xiao Mian Niang has had to pretend to be an innocent flower all her life, but she finally reveals her true dark nature and personally shoves the villain off a cliff. But... did she get the script wrong!? It's saying there's only one way to achieve the happy ending—to fall madly in love with the villain.

"Sister-in-law, I've adored you since childhood. Yet you deceived and betrayed me."

The villain gave her an icy smile,

"Now that I despise you to my core, you seriously expect me to fall in love with you again?"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

204652.description:
The miracle of a small agency, visual member Jung Ban-Han of idol group Blaze Tune, is beloved by many fans for his heavenly looks and character. Among Rix's countless fans, Lee Ju-Han's fandom grows so extreme it evolves into stalking. Believing his devotion betrayed by a small, careless action from Rix, Lee Ju-Han plans to kidnap him. He dips into his negative bank account and even resorts to illegal loans, spending money and time to uncover Rix's private life and home security code. Ultimately, he breaks into Rix's house and waits for him. Watching Rix secretly as he returns home, Lee Ju-Han witnesses an unexpected, chilling side of Rix...

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

204653.description:
While collecting a debt, a mage's blunder shrinks Hermi to just inches tall! To fund the cure, the mage scams the handsome Marquis Frey Ozette, a man obsessed with curios, by selling her to him as a rare fairy. Will Hermi ever regain her true size, or will she become Frey's most prized possession?

(Source: Manta)

Four people trapped in a dark space where time has stopped are offered to take part in a game by a mysterious being, and that it'll make the winner the luckiest person on Earth.

204657.description:
If your character dies, so do you.

"Running Family" is a game where you get to pick the characters to run along different stages. The catch is that the characters in the game are actual people. When a character dies, they disappear from reality as well. Meanwhile, a strange hole appears. Although it swallows certain people, it is invisible to others. How could this mysterious hole be linked to the game?

(Source: Manta)

On the verge of being sold off to pay her debts in the slums of Changseong, Jeong Hee-eon gets a second chance when gangster Lee Mugil hires her to work for him. Grateful and eager to prove her worth, she works hard by his side, slowly succumbing to the temptation of his warm presence. However, Mugil refuses to play the hero. 204670.description:
Every summer, she suffers nightmares of snakes slithering into her home. Like a dream that pursues her even when she flees, the past she believed forgotten knocked on her door once more. Having lived as a cold-hearted lawyer in Seoul, she returns to her hometown, Geumnak-ri, after 11 years, using consulting on a redevelopment association dispute as her excuse. To the place where her father's death had erased from her memory, where the hollowed-out past remained. There, a man held all of Hui-Jae's past in his grasp. Kim Se-Won, CEO of Geumseong D&C. A figure standing on the opposing side of her client, and simultaneously the one who left an indelible wound on Hui-Jae. Every time she faced him, Hui-Jae was overwhelmed by scenes she couldn't tell if they were dreams or memories. Red roses, an old side door, a school uniform, and the low voice that called her name.

"No matter how many times I see you, you're truly beautiful, Hui-Jae."

"If I kill your father for you, what will you give me?"

What happened in Geumnak-ri eleven years ago? Why does he remember everything, yet lost only himself...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Beneath the freezing skies of Titan, Saturn’s sixth moon, a team of extraterrestrial researchers and their AI companion uncover something that shouldn’t exist: a strange black sphere that defies all known laws of physics, plunging the team into a whirlwind of confusion and fear, and forcing them to confront a force beyond their comprehension.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

204683.description:
Dylan Russell is an exceptionally good-looking playboy who has traveled around the world. Jessica's crush on him was the biggest mistake of her childhood! Jessica visits the cabin she owns with her brother and coincidentally reunites with the man she never wanted to see again. Dylan says that he had wanted to spend some time alone there and had asked her older brother, Justin, to lend him the keys to the cabin. Jessica tries to kick him out, thinking that he's just running from an angry girlfriend, but they get stuck in the cabin together due to a storm. Unfortunately, Dylan is just as handsome as he was in the past. Jessica feels her heart waver, but she won't let herself fall for him again!

(Source: Renta!)

204684.description:
Colonel Willem Stone is taken behind enemy lines and there endures savage torture to protect his friends. Yet something mysterious happens to him whenever he's at the limit of his pain tolerance... It's as if his soul leaves his body and visits a mysterious woman in an ancient land. Her name is Sarafina. She has strong spiritual powers and is able to sense Will's presence?the two of them form a strong bond. But then Sarafina is transformed into a powerful vampire who never ages... Stay tuned as a unique and mythical romance blossoms!

(Source: Renta!)

204685.description:
Akari, who was dumped by her boyfriend of three years because she was too laid-back, happens to find an abandoned kitten. Akari, who names the kitten "Anko," gradually grows attached to the kitten and decides to move to an apartment building where cat owners gather, but...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

204686.description:
Mamori, a young girl whose parents have disappeared and whose only blood relative, her brother, is also missing, lives a lonely life. In one of her regular letters from her brother, she is offered a job as a bodyguard for a wealthy pair of twins, so she heads to the interview venue. Although the twins reject her, Mamori passes the interview, but ends up working at the boys' school the twins attend...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

204687.description:
It's the Taisho era, and Tougane Hana has become the daughter of a nouveau riche family thanks to her father's huge business success. However, she struggles to fit in at the aristocratic school she attends. Then, her father brings in Kitaoji Yumehiko, the son of a fallen aristocrat, to teach her manners...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

204700.description:
“Merry Christmas.”

When I opened my eyes after that unexpected drenching, an old friend stood before me, unrecognizable. Dan and Jerry, the wild duo who had attended every party during their college days, were friends who were so similar and well-matched, yet they drifted apart due to a certain incident. Ten years later, on a White Christmas Day, Jerry, who was gambling at a casino, was kidnapped by Dan. Dan then proposed a chess game to Jerry, making it a bet.

“If I win, let's go to ‘that forest’.”

As they played chess, recalling that incident they both wanted to forget, a tense atmosphere hung between them. In this uncomfortable situation, as Jerry tried to escape, Dan pointed a gun at him. And seeing Jerry, who could have killed him but didn't, Dan finally voiced the question buried deep in his heart...

“Back then, you...”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

204701.description:
Born into a legal family, Kojou runs a free legal consultation service in a corner of the university, but his ruthless "legal machine" has earned him horrible reviews. One day, a female student named Toga comes to him, asking him to solve a case...!?

A legal mystery in which a genius of logic and a genius of insight tackle a case that plagues students!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

A boy named Takagi is arrested on suspicion of murdering a male student. He has closed his heart off to adults, but a new counselor, a man named Nishina, appears before him and is a bit different from the previous ones...

A human drama in which a juvenile detention center counselor unravels the relationship between crime and the heart.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

204707.description:
Her older sister, Yoriko, lost everything due to her husband's infidelity, except for her son, Takato, who is a talented baseball player. Burning with revenge for her life, Yoriko remarries a man who works for a major company in order to financially support Takato in developing into a professional baseball player, but...

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

204708.description:
When a global blackout wipes out electricity overnight, shut-in inventor Ori Kenshi finds his carefully isolated life in the mountains of Okutama turned upside down. A mechanical genius who prefers machines to people, Kenshi once made a quiet living crafting intricate devices and anime weapons from his workshop. But when a meteor crashes into his garden during the outage, he carves it into a wand just to pass the time—only to discover that the meteors which destroyed the world’s power grids have unleashed something else entirely: magic. As civilization collapses and chaos spreads, Kenshi’s handmade wand might be the key to a new kind of power. Now this reluctant loner must step beyond the safety of his workshop and use his unusual talents to survive in a world where technology is gone and magic has taken its place.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Wand Maker in the Collapsing World

title.native: 崩壊世界の魔法杖職人

204709.description:
"Li Buhui was forced to marry her crush Xia Yusheng, but his heart only belongs to Wen Zhirou"

They are the three best friends growing up together, but have three different lives perspectively. It's a tangled and cheesy love triangle. Three years ago, someone framed her and made her vanish from sight. Three years later, when they met again, he still hated her. It took her three full years to forget him, but she still couldn't give up her desire to see him. She planned to see him for one last time, but an unexpected conspiracy was lurking around...

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: Hidden Marriage Love - You Are My Best Love

204710.description:
Tae-Hwa, a werewolf, has his coming-of-age ceremony and descends to the human world, enjoying campus life. However, after drinking alcohol at an OT, he flashes his ears and tail in front of Se-Hui! Se-Hui, seeing this, finds it amusing and begins to torment and obsess over Tae-Hwa as if he were his own puppy...

"Tae-Hwa, be my pet dog."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Chika, a boy who cannot reveal his hobbies and interests to others, gradually becomes attracted to his friend's older sister, Hanako.

204712.description:
Ling Yun Ge fought to gain power over the country for the one she loved, helping him obtain the Crown Prince title - only to be met with lies and betrayal. Desperately heartbroken, she suffered from complete exile. Upon her return, she was determined to make those who had harmed her pay... Finally, after the revenge is complete, she at last laid eyes on the one who had always stayed by her side to protect her. But who would have thought everything was within his calculations. Is this truly what the truth of the story is?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: This Love is Like A Song

204713.description:
After the conclusion of the Golden Coffin case, the youths formed a powerful bond. But even then, they were forced to go their separate ways eventually. Finding it meaningless to return to Tianwaitian, Xiao Se and Lei Wujie began their journey to Xueyue City. The wind blew in Shangguan, the flower bloomed in Xiaguan. The snow fell in the mountains, the moon reflected on Erhai Lake. After going through many hardships, Xiao Se and Lei Wujie had finally reached the gates of Xueyue City. However, the Dengtian Pavilion stopped them in their tracks. Outside of the Dengtian Pavilion was the mortal city. Only once they passed the Dengtian Pavilion would they be able to see Xueyue. Lei Wujie longed to see the person that he wanted to see. Xiao Se wanted to make Lei Wujie pay up. And so, they climbed up the Dengtian Pavilion. What they didn't know was that their arrival was but a prelude to a storm of blood…

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: The Singers of Wind, Flower, Snow, and Moon

title.english: The Great Journey of Teenagers: Folly of Youths Arc

204714.description:
Lin Qingchun never expected her fiancé and best friend's betrayal a night before her betrothal. Even more surprising, she was reborn! Her life came back again, and the first thing she decided to do was to leave that scumb*g. He who lives next door keeps on saving her out of trouble repeatedly, he was even willing to help her get revenge?! They were just friends at the beginning, but then they started to grow closer.

(Source: WebComics)

204715.description:
At the tender age of five, Shin Jae-Won first met Park Sang-Eon at his parents' funeral. Taken in and raised together, Jae-Won’s gratitude eventually blossomed into a deep, secret yearning by the age of fourteen. At twenty, fueled by liquid courage, he finally confessed his feelings—only for a miracle to occur. His love was reciprocated, and Jae-Won believed he had secured a lifetime of domestic bliss with his incredibly devoted and skilled lover, a man fifteen years his senior.

However, the fairy tale shattered at age twenty-seven when Jae-Won spotted Sang-Eon in a place he should never have been. The man he thought he knew was gone, replaced by a stranger shrouded in secrets. Staring down the man who had been his entire world, Jae-Won demands the cold, hard truth with a trembling heart: "Explain yourself. From the very beginning. Everything." Their lifelong bond now hangs by a fragile thread.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Until I Call Your Name Three Times

title.english: Until You Say My Name Thrice

204716.description:
Hiroya Oku’s first completely new series in four years! The protagonists are... six middle-aged men?!

The story is set in a share house inhabited by six men approaching their 60s. In this "utopia" filled with men who have seemingly given up on their current lives, an unimaginable development is about to unfold.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

204717.description:
Seo Jae-Ha, the illegitimate son of a wealthy family, aspires to become the heir to his family. After a failed investment, he becomes a debtor, betraying his former classmate, a stranger named Yu-Jin, by offering him a sexual partner. He is then manipulated into becoming a debtor. A chance encounter transports him back to his high school days. To escape this predicament, he begins to treat Yu-Jin kindly. Will Jae-Ha be able to overcome this predicament and ascend to the throne? The protagonist, a second-generation chaebol who has always sought success and disregarded human connection, discovers true love with a man with whom he had a bitter past.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

204718.description:
Liu Yijun, a celebrity manager working for MCN Entertainment, was blackmailed by Xia Yang, a university student injured in a traffic accident. Since then, Xia Yang moved to her place. Never did she expect this good-looking, honey-mouthed boy to be an excellent cook of Sichuan cuisine. Hence, she decided to make him a live streamer specializing in Sichuan cuisine. Without realizing it, she was falling deeper and deeper into the boy's love trap.

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: The Escargot Boy Lives in the Attic

title.english: The Pretty Houseboy in the Attic

204719.description:
Locked in a pristine white room with your hyperdominant alpha childhood friend is one thing. Being forced by an anonymous captor to perform explicit, depraved acts with him just to survive is another. When Ju Do-Hyeon and Woo Tae-Yun are abruptly abducted, they initially suspect a high-stakes ransom plot or a crazed stalker. But the truth is far more wicked. A single phone in the center of the room lights up with a series of perverse missions, forcing them to cross every boundary they have spent a lifetime establishing. Now, Do-Hyeon and Tae-Yun must choose between their lifelong friendship and their dirtiest, most primal instincts. As the demands escalate from humiliating to downright hardcore, the lines between forced submission and genuine desire begin to blur. But the deeper they go into these twisted missions, the less they find themselves wanting to escape...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Locked up With My Childhood Friend
和兒時玩伴一起被囚禁了

204720.description:
A boy group suddenly burst into fame and became the hottest group throughout the country! An ordinary girl who works in a convenience store, encounters the idol, Pearson and attracts him with her gentle and kindness. The co-living life begins with sweet and many accidents! Could the prince and Ciderella get together forever?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Home Sweet Home: Living With My Celebrity Boyfriend

title.native: 与明星男友同居的生活
title.romaji: Yu Mingxing Nanyou De Tongju Shenghuo

204721.description:
While in middle school, Zhou Chaohai accidentally took in a baby octopus. Years later, they meet again—only for the octopus to confess to him?! Outer God, Chaos, Whispers, the Abyss... Entanglement, complications, turmoil, demands... Ahem, shhh~~ Buried in debt, Zhou Chaohai finds himself forcibly bound, sinking deeper into the entanglement with each step.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Moon Rises With The Tide

204722.description:
Being reborn in a mysterious ancient country, the modern girl becomes a princess who is going to be married with one of the princes so as to make peace between two countries. She thinks it will be a happy beginning of her romantic love, however, it turns that they only want her wolf heart. In the meantime, this girl finds that another soul co-exists with her in her body...

(Source: WebComics)

204723.description:
The story of a man who was reincarnated into another world as an Incubus inside an Erotic Trap Dungeon, but wants to enjoy a cheerful Isekai Life, so proceeds to ascend through the dungeon and make his way to the surface. However, he carelessly falls for various erotic traps even though he is an incubus!

(Source: DLsite)
synonyms: 전생했더니 에로 함정 던전의 음마가 됐지만 밝은 이세계 생활을 꿈꾸며 지상으로 나갑
转生之后变成了色情陷阱迷宫的魅魔，但为了实现明朗的异世界生活走出迷宫来到地上
轉生後成為色情陷阱地下城裡的淫魔 但是為了過上明亮的異世界生活而去地上

title.english: Reincarnated as an Incubus in an Erotic Trap Dungeon ~I’m leaving for a Cheerful Isekai Life~
title.native: 転生したらエロトラップダンジョンの淫魔になってたけど明るい異世界生活を目指して地上に出ます
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Ero Trap Dungeon no Inma ni Natteta kedo Akarui Isekai Seikatsu wo Mezashite Chijou ni Demasu

204724.description:
Born with the best physique in the world through the Tao-Reverse-Three-Yang-Returning-To-Nation technique, the first person to teach him how to speak was his grandfather, who had dementia. The policeman was the scariest, and the sweets were the most delicious.

"All those who pick a fight will be destroyed by this policeman! You should know that no one who messes with me comes out unscathed!"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

204725.description:
Hun-Gi, the protagonist, lives a jungle-like school life and is treated like cold rice at home, so he is always teased and ignored wherever he goes. He has no presence, no confidence, no interest in sports, and is an ordinary high school student. One day, Hun-Gi tries to confess to the girl he likes, but he realizes how worthless he is and falls into deep despair. Then, by chance, he gets a skateboard and it talks to the protagonist who is lost in sorrow. The board, which has a personality opposite to the protagonist's, stimulates the protagonist and he starts to do whatever it tells him. As a result, he gains unexpected things, and the protagonist's personality gradually changes.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

204726.description:
"If I had a brother, my family wouldn't have ended up like this!"

Oh Won-Seok, a timid but kind-hearted otaku boy. His family has been falling apart day by day since his brother's accident 10 years ago. Won-Seok, who didn't give in to school violence and endured each day with his favorite character, Airi-Jing, is sent to his grandmother's house to avoid the eyes of loan sharks. Left alone, Won-Seok hears a mysterious voice and follows the voice to find a talking skateboard?!! The meeting of a talking skateboard and an otaku boy! What kind of events await them ahead?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

204728.hashtag: #ビター・スイート・ブレイクタイム

title.native: ビター・スイート・ブレイクタイム

204729.description:
Ahn Cha-Woo is the ultimate magnet for terrible boyfriends. Every relationship ends the same way, and the latest one does not even last six months before ending in betrayal. Why is love never on his side? Is it really too much to hope for a boyfriend who is polite, handsome, fit, and, well, generously endowed? Cha-Woo cannot help feeling the universe is being unfair.

“Forget it. I am done with dating.”

But just as he swears off romance, someone catches his eye, Nam Do-Ha, who happens to be polite, handsome, fit, and…everything else on his list. Of course, Do-Ha looks like the definition of a straight campus golden boy, so Cha-Woo quickly crushes his own interest. Until Doha suddenly lights up and says, “Wow, really? Then could you buy me lunch tomorrow?” A throwaway comment, taken seriously. Maybe, just maybe, this time will be different.

(Source: Lezhin US)

204730.description:
Getting rejected is a daily occurrence, but never give up!! The story of Gyao-Wo and his friends' ups and downs in love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204731.description:
The sham marriage of So-Hyeon, a virgin who dreams of escaping Joseon, and the crown prince, who must protect his position, takes place in the Joseon Dynasty. True to its time, women are divided into women and men into men. Women's expected behavior is set in stone, and they can only learn the basics: sewing, bridal lessons, and cooking ancestral rites food. Men, on the other hand, can attend Sungkyunkwan, pursue academic pursuits, and rise through the ranks. So-Hyeon had to steal what the men were learning. She had been studying on her own since childhood, using every means possible. Her dream was to leave Joseon, learn more, and travel the world. However, once she gets married, everything goes up in smoke. Will So-Hyeon successfully complete her sham marriage and achieve her dreams? If her sham marriage is discovered, she'll die! To avoid being caught, she'll have to give it her all!

(Source: Naver, translated)

204733.description:
Naver Webtoon has already celebrated its 20th anniversary! What works have graced Naver Webtoon over the years? To explore the path, legendary and rookie gag writers have joined forces...

"The Sound of Your Heart" writer Jo Seok introduces 10 masterpieces from the first 10 years of the webtoon, while "The Ki Sisters" writer Beombae introduces 10 masterpieces from the second 10 years of the webtoon.
