This special collaboration celebrates Naver Webtoon's 20th anniversary.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

204734.description: Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 57, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for digital release.

title.native: ためしにコマンド言ってみた 番外編
title.romaji: Tameshi ni Command Itte Mita: Bangai-hen

204736.description:
In my new world, life has no worth. Reborn as an apprentice under the Order of Assassins, an organization that takes on all manner of underhanded jobs, I’m prepared to do anything and everything to survive.

First, I have to get through their oppressive training, where failure equals death. My assassin-to-be rivals include a tigerborn whose strength eclipses my own, an elf who is a master of essence, and a dragonborn, their kind known as the mightiest of races. Isn’t all that almost unfair? Although death lurks around every corner, I swear I’ll claw my way through this hell. Manipulating powerful foes and the adults around me, punishing those who stand in my way… If that makes me a monster, so be it.

There is nothing and no one I won’t tear down for the sake of survival. Not a shred of morality sees the light in this darkest of fantasies.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: 暗殺者（アサシン）の卵に転生した　～最凶外道の少年は、生き残るために手段を選ばない～
Ansatsusha no Tamago ni Tensei Shita: Saikyou Gedou no Shounen wa, Ikinokoru tame ni Shudan wo Erabanai

title.native: 暗殺者の卵に転生した　～最凶外道の少年は、生き残るために手段を選ばない～
title.romaji: Assassin no Tamago ni Tensei Shita: Saikyou Gedou no Shounen wa, Ikinokoru Tame ni Shudan wo Erabanai

204737.description:
Admission to Jungle High School, a prestigious private school! Welcome to Jungle High School, a school renowned for its diverse student body and educational excellence, where all unnecessary extraneous education is eliminated.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204739.description:
"This time, I'll protect my happy family for sure!"

Takhir, a young baron who had lost his beloved family, was unable to do anything and thus labeled as an incompetent. However, as he was dying, his time-space magic suddenly manifested and he regained the memories of his previous life before being transported back to his childhood?!

He no longer faltered in the face of war or the epidemic. He vowed to use his revived modern knowledge to improve their level of civilization... and to change his family's fate! By using his knowledge of the future, he was determined to reduce the damage caused by the poor harvest and flood, while doing everything he could to get talented individuals on his side, strengthening the Solis barony! By moving without concerning himself with the gaze of others, he would go beyond the Kair Kingdom, altering history across the entire continent!

With his "family-first principle", the child prodigy would alter his depressing fate! His unprecedentedly large rebellion story begins!

(Source: TO Books, translated)
synonyms: My Second Life... or So I Thought, but It's Actually My Third Life: Using My Knowledge of History and Domestic Policies to Change the Unfortunate History
2-dome no Jinsei, to Omottara, Jitsu wa 3-dome Datta. @COMIC

title.native: 2度目の人生、と思ったら、実は3度目だった。～歴史知識と内政努力で不幸な歴史の改変に挑みます～@COMIC
title.romaji: 2-dome no Jinsei, to Omottara, Jitsu wa 3-dome Datta.: Rekishi Chishiki to Naisei Doryoku de Fukou na Rekishi no Kaihen ni Idomimasu @COMIC

204740.description:
Lin Xiaomu, whose life deeply revolved around playing the "supporting role," had finally made contact with the school hunk, Huo Dongze, after an incident. In her eyes, he was "dazzling." Who would've thought that he, too, cared a lot about her as well?! Maybe it was the day that I met you that my life had become dazzling and radiating…

(Source: Coolmic)

204743.description:
For 20 years, Hyeonseok fought monsters in another world before finally managing to save it and be sent back to Earth as a reward. Now a former deliveryman named Chanseok, he looks forward to enjoying modern conveniences, only to discover that Earth is very different from what he remembers. Monsters have started appearing from Erosion Points that pop up at random, and people with innate abilities become Hunters to defeat them. Reluctantly, Chanseok applies to become a Hunter himself, mostly for the money. He saved the world once before, so how hard can it be the second time?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: กู้โลกอีกครั้งไม่ยากนักหรอก

title.english: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff

204744.description:
Three meals today, posterity tomorrow, all in reverie.

(Source: Official Site)
synonyms: 暮歳閑談：これは平凡な人生

title.english: Sui's Daily Slices: Mundane Mortal Life
title.native: 暮岁闲谈：这是平凡人生
title.romaji: Musui Xiantan: Zhei Shi Pingfang Rensheng

204745.description:
High school student Himeka adores cake but faints whenever she eats it, which leaves her in a constant state of irritation. However, one day, her classmate Masaru informs her that her fainting is actually the result of a curse…?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 神様の並ぶケーキ屋さん

204746.description:
When the dust settles, the Elite emerge.

(Source: Official Site)
synonyms: エリートオペレーター：出帆

title.romaji: Kaze no Sakai, Tsubasa no Hate

204749.description:
Hajime Ookami, a new member of the workforce, is so nervous the night before his first day that he can’t sleep. Plagued by anxiety over whether he can make it in this distant, unfamiliar city of Fukuoka, Hajime heads out for a midnight stroll. There, he is accosted by a strangely over-familiar, "giant" drunk woman, and the two of them end up heading out into the nighttime city together...!? Set in Hakata, this is a heart-pounding story depicting the budding relationship between a grown man and woman!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: デカいうさぎに懐かれた!?

204750.description:
After losing her beloved brother and suffering from infertility, Nomiya Kaoru meets her brother's ex-girlfriend, Onodera Senna. Kaoru, who has decided to help at Kafune, a housekeeping agency where Senna works, deepens her bond with her through food.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

204751.description:
A young man named Xia Tian suddenly acquired X-ray vision, and from then on, he made his great comeback. He studied under a martial arts master and made friends with antiques appraisers... He kept getting stronger and became a versatile martial arts ace step by step!

(Source: Webnovel)

204754.description:
Can love be reignited between the woman who has lost all memories of her past lover and the heartbroken man who was forgotten?

(Source: Lalatoon)

204755.description: Wendy Xu, an ill-behaved teen girl who was in heavy debts, suddenly became a young lady of a wealthy family?! She established a firm footing in the complex relationships of this family, found her biological brother who was protective to her and fell in love with the president who helped her. But she didn't know that everyone was trying to conceal a shocking truth from her...

204756.description:
Notable talent agent Jiang Langning is accidentally killed and sent into the past, where beauty is regarded as a sign of supremacy. With a wealth of experience and an eye for talent, she discovers a pleasure-seeking but smart man Chu Yudu, a meek old-money guy Gu Nanyi, an aloof scholar Shen Yanqing, and a loyal bodyguard Xie Sa. The four are selected to form a band that quickly becomes a nationwide phenomenon.

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: あきらめ令嬢は恋心なんていらない。～裏切られたはずなのに、婚約者からの溺愛が止まりません！～
title.romaji: Akirame Reijou wa Koigokoro Nante Iranai.: Uragirareta Hazu nanoni, Konyakusha Kara no Dekiai ga Tomarimasen!

204759.description:
If you have seven days left in your life. What do you want to do? The death notice issued by the skybound death bureau experiment is as short as seven days, whether you have ever lived at the top of the world or struggled at the edge of life. There is always stumbling, always miss, always regret... It doesn't really matter how you die; How to live is the point.

(Source: WebComics)

204760.description:
After taking her own life for her country, the ancient princess traveled to a costume drama set in the modern world. What a strange place! The man, with short hair looked exactly like her Prince Consort! Chu Yao, a popular actor, was accidentally killed after declining the hype plan designed by his company. Unexpectedly, he found he was reborn back to a few months before his death, facing the same hype plan choice again. However, if he declined to cooperate with the strange woman, would he somehow die?! One for true love in the previous life, the other for surviving, the couple have to get close to each other and carry out the hype plan...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: My Husband Wants to Fry CP With Me
My Husband Wants to Pretend With Me

title.romaji: Wo Jia Fuma Jing Yao He Wo Chao CP

204761.description:
Chief researcher Yanjing Zhuang came to a remote research facility with her bodyguard, Xiangyang Zuo. She was supposed to help in the development of a cancer cure, but an accident broke out in the lab. With the help of other survivors in the research facility, they must find a way to escape!

(Source: INKR)

204763.description:
The countries of Calista and Aristo are split in two like the fabled broken diamond. A legend states that the person who finds the missing part of the diamond will become the true king. But these tales have nothing to do with housekeeper Effie. Then, out of the blue, she is chosen as a maid by King Zakari and sent to the desert. She was nervous as she timidly entered the king's tent, but when the handsome, strong king informed her that she was to share his bed, Effie ran away...still wearing the glittering pendant she had received from her late mother.

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Sabaku no Ou ni Ai wo Sasage

204764.description:
Pippa knows the only sure way to avoid heartbreak is to avoid love in the first place.

Whenever attorney Pippa starts hearing Christmas carols in town, she throws herself into her work to forget her heartbreak from a Christmas long ago. Then one day Pippa meets businessman Roscoe and he asks for an unusual favor. He wants her to make his brother fall for her in order to lure him away from his delinquent friends. Pippa is annoyed that he sees her value only in her beauty, but she ends up accepting the job anyway. Soon she starts to see Roscoe more clearly—he’s just like her. They’ve both closed off their hearts from love.

204765.description:
Travelling back, the secret service was forced to get married! It is said that her husband will bring misfortune to her, and his mistresses are everywhere!? Someone bring those bitches here! I’ll tear them into pieces and divorce my husband!!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Evil Prince's Incomparable Evil Princess

title.romaji: Xie Wang De Jueshi Du Fei

204766.description:
"Oh, no! Sounds like a heartbeat…"

A long-time-single fashion designer refuses all kinds of matchmaking! But unexpectedly, a young pup shows up in the middle of the road. ”Take me, Miss! I beg you, please.” "Hey! Don't get so close to me, you big bad wolf!" Can she stay single this time?

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: Asking You to Date Is Too Hard
Falling in Love With You Is Hard

title.english: It's Hard To Make You Fall in Love
title.romaji: Qing Ni Lianai Tai Nan Le!

204767.description:
Adapted from the novel 'The Most Powerful Learning System', Su Mo discovers that the secret to academic excellence is... love. Who says dating gets in the way of your studies? With the Learning System installed, anyone can become a star student instantly!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Super God and School Beauty Initially Love
Super God Starts From Falling In Love With The Schoolgirl

title.english: Legendary! It Started with a Date
title.native: 超神从和校花恋爱开始
title.romaji: Chao Shen Cong He Xiaohua Lian'ai Kaishi

204768.description:
Garrett, a lecturer by day and a playboy at heart, wanted a hot woman to be his date when he appeared on the TV show Blindside Date, and he chose Jayde. Jayde, a struggling student dedicated to social causes, was shocked by Garrett's proposal. She planned to reject it, but when the show's host said they could set up a televised fund-raising opportunity in exchange for her participation, Jayde had second thoughts...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 世紀のファーストキス

204769.description:
Marketing manager Emily works hard at her father's company. But her father is determined that Emily should marry one of the six eligible bachelors he's found who work at the company. Emily isn't interested in an arranged marriage, however, so she plays cupid to the first five bachelors on the list and finds them their perfect mates. But before she can set up the sixth candidate, Jack Devon, with his true love, her father demands that she go on a business trip with Jack! How is Emily going to handle the nights with this undeniably attractive man? Will she be able to stick to her plan?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: プレイボーイのためらい

204771.description:
With excellent medical skills, he brings the dying back to life. With a pair of powerful fists, he fights against thousands of enemies. Walking between death and power, he breaks rules, rescues all living creatures and dominates the city, thus starting an exciting journey among cities.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Amazing Doctor in the City

204772.description:
Three years ago, Si Ning and her team rose to fame after winning the Summoner's Cup. However, after learning that her boyfriend and teammate cheated on her, she withdrew from professional play, vowing to never return. Three years later, she became a full-time video game streamer, sporting her new long peppermint green tresses. Through hard work, her stream steadily grew until one day, a random in-game opponent destroyed her 5-0 in front of all her viewers. Unfortunately for her, the embarassing defeat went viral. Her opponent turned out to be the newest sensation in pro player circles, superstar Ye Feisheng, who continued to be a major thorn in her side. He regularly showed up uninvited, first plying her stream with massive donations, then visiting her home in person with a large horde of fans in tow. Why does this little brat keep bugging me? What does he want?? Watch as she fights back to reap the seeds of success and love!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: I Wait for in the Spring Water
Waiting for You at the Spring

title.romaji: Wo Zai Quan Shui Deng Ni

204773.description:
Soren Shen is a high school student. He's always a well-behaved student to his teachers and takes Sharon Li as his good example, who is the school idol. But one day... Soren accidentally found the secrets of his idol!?

(Source: WebComics)

204774.description:
At the end of Yinguo Alley was the Triduum Pawnshop. Just like its name, there was a three-day deadline for the antiques to be reclaimed. The young girl Dong Xiaoxia who looked after the shop alone had powerful empathetic abilities. Not only could she see the "Spirit" formed from the spirit fragments in the antiques, but she could also hear their stories and their obsession. She could even accept their requests. And once she completed the antiques' wishes one by one, the Ivy Lock on Xiaoxia's chest would also glow softly. What kind of past was sealed behind the golden lock once all the ivies had receded…

(Source: Coolmic)

204775.description:
In order to change the fate of its owner, Liancheng—a maid of the Royal Kitchen—and Little Lihua—a white cat who had been granted wisdom but had no demonic power—travelled through time with Liancheng's body under the help of the demon king to change Liancheng's fate of inevitable death.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Fantasy of the Buried Beauty: Lihua & Liancheng

204777.description:
Qi Xiaotian, a youngster staying by himself, accidentally discovered a mysterious magic circle in the basement while he was trying to expand his villa. Curiosity led him to place his hand on the seal and with a flash of light, a majestic blonde haired girl walked out from the circle! "Are you my...wait a minute! Why are you pulling out your sword?! Let's talk this over!!"

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: My Home Has a Teleportation Array

title.english: There's a Teleportation Circle in My Basement!
title.romaji: Wo Jia You Ge Chuansong Zhen

204778.description:
This home was left by our good friend, Smile. Take a look at their new daily life as three online-met friends move in together to their new house.

(Source: Lalatoon)

204779.description:
Magic Capital! A metropolis that has everything! Here, there is a man that comes and goes like the wind : The Real Boss !! In this realistic society, he hunts as a lone wolf. On his path towards ladies and the truth, he inches further away day by day!!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Praying For Peace: This World has Been Dominated by the Real Boss!!
title.native: 祈求和平!这个世界被真实大佬统治了!!
title.romaji: Qiqiu Heping! Zhege Shijie Bei Zhenshi Dalao Tongshi Le!!

204780.description:
"Sam?" Samantha turns around after hearing a voice from her past call out her name. Standing there is Reed Connors. They had a dreamlike time together, but he abandoned her and never contacted her again. In return for loving him, Samantha fell pregnant and lost her dreams and her family. Raising the child in her hometown, she has finally gotten on track with her work and the wounds of her heart have started to heal... so why has Reed shown up again now, of all times? Samantha treats him coolly after their nine-year estrangement, yet she responds without thinking to Reed's kiss!

(Source: Renta!)

204781.description: When Megan was young and studying abroad in England, her boyfriend, Nicholas, dumped her, explaining that he was the heir to a noble family and he had to marry a noblewoman. She returned home heartbroken, and never received a response to the one letter she sent him. The letter had been her last hope, but he never replied despite the unresolved issues between them. Now, ten years later, Megan is again in England and working as a lecturer. She enjoys reliving the nostalgic days of her youth, but she’s moved on. So what is she to think when Nicholas suddenly appears before her?

204782.description:
Jo is completely focused on her job as an accountant, which is apparently why her long-term boyfriend decided to leave her. Unable to handle the sorrow alone, she turns to her best friend, Liam, for comfort. He's always taken care of her when she was in pain, but now, for some reason, neither of them can contain their desire, and they end up spending the night together. The next morning before they part ways, they promise to forget the whole thing and stay friends. But now Jo is pregnant...and Liam is insisting they get married. Jo believes it's only for the sake of the baby, but could it mean more?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 嬉しくないプロポーズ

204783.description:
Deeply hurt by her fiance's betrayal, Dani breaks off her engagement and decides to start life over in a new town with a new job. She leaves Seattle for a small coastal town, where she's lucky to find work as an antiques shop assistant. But her boss, John, writes her off as a fickle vacationer who will leave as soon as the summer is over, and he treats her coldly. Both Dani and John are haunted by old wounds. But as they work together, they gradually get to know each other...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: シンデレラは涙をふいて

204784.description:
Interior designer Eva received a job offer from Markos to renovate his penthouse in New York. Markos is a rich and successful playboy who is known for toying with women and then dumpingInterior designer Eva received a job offer from Markos to renovate his penthouse in New York. Markos is a rich and successful playboy who is known for toying with women and then dumping them. Eva hears the rumor about his reputation from her cousin, one of his recent victims. And then Markos sets his eyes upon Eva, who has canceled her appointment with him twice. Not able to forget her painful past, Eva attempts avoid Markos's advances, yet somehow she finds herself kissing him anyway... them. Eva hears the rumor about his reputation from her cousin, one of his recent victims. And then Markos sets his eyes upon Eva, who has canceled her appointment with him twice. Not able to forget her painful past, Eva attempts avoid Markos's advances, yet somehow she finds herself kissing him anyway...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ひざまずいたプレイボーイ

204785.description:
Lisane attends a lively party with her lover, Zac. He is a skilled lawyer and millionaire with a magnetic charm. Other women are always pursuing him. And every time she sees them on his tail, Lisane is reminded that she and Zac have made no promises to each other, that nothing ensures Zac will stay at her side. A couple of weeks later, she's both elated and anxious to learn that she's pregnant with Zac's child. But that same day she sees something in the newspaper that makes her heart stutter-it's an announcement of Zac's engagement to another woman!

(Source: Renta!)

204786.description:
Five years ago Emily lost her husband and her unborn child in a fire caused by a construction company that was cutting corners. She has finally recovered and decided to start a new life, but the large scar on her back will always remind her of what happened. One day, a mysterious stranger named Mitch walks into her life. He melts her heart, but she's afraid of what he'll say when he sees the scar she keeps hidden. Little does she know that Mitch is hiding something, too... What will happen when she learns his true identity?

(Source: Renta!)

204787.description:
Kanenari, an obedient office worker, signs up for a maid dispatch service in a weak heart. It turns out to be a plot (?) by a demon who uses human emotions as her magical power! "My name is Verrier. I am a demon who feeds on disobedient emotions and will not bow to anyone." A romantic comedy of explosive emotions with a disobedient maid and devilish roommate!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

204788.description:
Olivia has just arrived at the home of her London lover, who sets her heart alight. However, the man who appears at the door, Decan, coldly tells her that this is his home and he has no idea where her lover is. What is she supposed to do now? Unwilling to leave Olivia to deal with her troubles alone, Decan introduces her to one of his acquaintances who runs an apartment building. Seemingly abandoned by her lover, Olivia realizes she is strangely drawn to Decan. She sees him around town and he shows up in her dreams. How can she resist his gentle smile?

(Source: Renta!)

204789.description:
Shy Octavia marries Italian businessman Alessandro under her father's orders. Their initial plans was for her to marry his cousin Primo, but he turned her down. She had been fortunate enough to be proposed to by Alessandro. He loved her day and night and she eventually fulfills her desire to become pregnant, but is shocked when he tells her to go to London on her own to have the baby delivered by a noted doctor. Why doesn't he want to be with her? Octavia had a reason to be concerned. Primo had told her the truth about her marriage and a certain plan that Alessandro had.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: イタリア富豪の孤独な妻
title.romaji: Italia Fugou no Kodoku na Tsuma

204790.description:
The "Fox Window" is the ability to see mysterious things invisible to the naked eye by crossing your fingers in a special way and looking through the resulting hole (window). This story follows the encounters and interactions between the protagonist Nagi, a user of the Fox Window, and various monsters lurking in the human world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

204791.description:
Jennifer has always had feelings for her boss, Alex, but he won't look her way. She decides to find a new love, so she participates in an auction...where she ends up winning a date with Alex of all people! What is he doing in a place like this? Jennifer wants to refuse the date, but Alex has no problem going out with her. And the moment he captures her lips in a kiss, she can't say anything to resist!

(Source: Renta!)

204792.description:
When her parents passed away six years ago, Beatrice gave up on her dreams to raise her brothers and sisters. Not only is she self-conscious about her appearance, but her family treats her like a servant. One night, while helping her sister with a party, she reunites with Elliot Chalmers, who tells her the painful truth-she isn't being treated right. She tries to argue with him. She just can't stand being around the man. If only she knew how Elliot really feels and that he and only wants what's best for her.

(Source: Renta!)

204793.description:
One night, Hani, a teacher on a small tropical island, suffers from a fit at a local festival. A man named Kelt with cold, beautiful copper eyes and a strong body offers to help her. Even though she swore she'd never love again, Hani feels her heart throbbing fast. She's the princess of Moraz, who had to leave her country after she helped commit a shameful crime. With such a secret, such a past, she doesn't have the right to love anyone...

(Source: Renta!)

204794.description:
Reporter Sarah is in a real bind after losing one of the red heels she secretly borrowed from work to write an article about. But as she's bemoaning her fate, a shocking figure appears-Caleb, the young CEO of a popular design company. He hints that he might have picked up the heel and demands Sarah write an article about his company. Confused by his conditions, she grudgingly accepts the trade, all the while trying her best not to fall for him.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 孤独な夜のシンデレラ

204795.description:
Due to her sister's infertility, Sheridan decides to undergo artificial insemination, but as a result of the hospital's mistake, she is provided with the semen of a man who is not her brother-in-law. As it turns out, the semen belongs to Rashid, the King of Kyr. Though Sheridan finds him authoritarian, he is as handsome as any prince you might read about in The Arabian Nights. Sheridan frantically resists Rashid's urgings that she should join him in Kyr, but then he makes an unimaginable move, sweeping Sheridan up off her feet and kissing her passionately. Sheridan suddenly finds herself lost in Kyr's intense passion... What will she do next?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: One Hundred and One Nights with the Desert King

204796.description:
Photographer Daisy worked a wedding at an earl's castle, but by the time she was ready to leave, her car was completely snowed in! She had only until midnight to upload the day's photos and didn't know how she'd be able to pull it off now. Luckily a man showed up and invited Daisy into the castle. Once she successfully uploaded the photos, she noticed how very attractive the man who helped her was. They proceeded to spend a dreamy night together, but they didn't yet know how that night would change their destiny...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 伯爵との一夜のあとで
title.romaji: Hakushaku to no Ichiya no Ato de

204797.description:
At her temping job Maya must deal with sexual harassment from her boss-and when she's in danger of being assaulted at a party, popular playwright Blaise Walker comes to the rescue. He's every woman's dream and he even asked her out! But Maya knows she mustn't fall for those eyes of his! She turns down Blaise's offer and quits her job. That's when Blaise offers her a new job at his country villa?he proposes that she be his writing assistant for a few weeks!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Secretary by Day, Mistress by Night
title.romaji: Boss to no Yoru wa Yume no Naka

204798.description:
Discovering he's the father of a newborn, Liam hires a beautiful nanny. Despite going through a tough time as a single mother, Jenna appears to be well-bred, making it harder for Liam to resist her. For her part, Jenna is busy hiding her identity as a princess. She fled to the United States in order to hide her relationship with her deceased boyfriend. When she's obliged to go back to her own country, Jenna must fight her feelings for Liam, which she finds have grown much stronger than she'd realized...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ナニーが恋した大富豪

204799.description:
The father mysteriously disappeared, the mother committed suicide, and the hidden truth was discovered from the clues. Chai Nana, the master of decryption who inherited the mysterious Yangyu Ukey, turned into a socialite and decided to serve the man with her beauty. She made a hidden rule deal with Mr. Mo, the most powerful boss in S City. Who wants to summon the warm side of the man with a kiss! One is cold as ice, the other is warm...

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Boyfriend is half sweet and half salt

title.romaji: Nan You Ban Tang Ban Yan

204800.description:
A sudden wave of zombies swept across campus. MC was lucky to escape the original man-made disaster, but could not escape the turbulent suffering. Human nature, life, future, everything is crumbling. In order to survive, partners join each other and leave one after another. Under tremendous pressure of survival, can you still be able to keep your true heart and keep going as a human？

(Source: WebComics)

204801.description:
"Yue Ying ended up in a different world, where she was a badass brigand"

Lady Bandit’s Gentleman Hunt: Adapted from the novel “Lady Peerless Bandit: Carrying Home a Husband” by A’Li. Yue Ying was a successful and wealthy president, but she was pushed down the staircase, being mistaken as someone’s mistress. When she opened her eyes again, she realized she had traversed through time and space, into another world, and became a female bandit. However, there are benefits of being a bandit. “I’ll make the man whom I’ve laid my eyes on, mine!”

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: A Slender Gentleman and a Good Lady

title.native: 窈窕君子 女将好逑
title.romaji: Yao Tiao Jun Zi Nü Jiang Hao Qiu

204802.description:
"Let's ask her directly, with a truth serum."

Miranda, the second Grand Duchess of the Grand Duchy of Fagor, is known as the "Villain of All Time," with a notoriety that reaches even neighboring countries. At one time she sleeps with her sister's husband, at another time she plots the assassination of the Grand Duke and his wife, abuses her sisters, and plots invasions of other countries -- she has done every evil deed possible, but in fact she has something she is hiding...? The awkward relationship between the villain and the mad king deepens with the help of a truth serum. When these two evil people team up, they become a threat that can shake even a great nation!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Scheme of a Wicked Woman

title.native: 傾国悪女のはかりごと～初夜に自白剤を盛るとは何事か!～
title.romaji: Keikoku Akujo no Hakari Goto: Shoya ni Jihaku-zai wo Moru to wa Nanigoto ka!

204803.description:
Pressed into marrying a general of the enemy nation, she would find only her future husband’s rejection and a cold reception in her new homeland…

As the daughter of a powerful marquess in a small, prosperous nation, Bertine was raised with all the privileges and expectations befitting her station. Yet not long before her wedding day, the king orders her to marry Cecilio instead, a representative of the nation victorious against her own. For she was part of the war reparations. Resigned to her fate, despair in her heart, she crosses the ocean, bound for her new home.

But all that awaited her was Cecilio’s absence and his servants’ humiliating treatment of her. “I can’t rely on my parents or my status. So I shall gain the strength to survive here through my own efforts.” Alone and armed only with her resolve, Bertine flees the estate and begins to carve a path that will allow her to live in enemy territory…

A young lady possessed of a hidden talent for business. A general known as “The Battle-Crazed Savage.” And their love story, predicated by a misunderstanding and a negotiation starts here!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)
synonyms: A Young Lady Finds Her True Calling Living With the Enemy

title.native: 小国の侯爵令嬢は敵国にて覚醒する
title.romaji: Oguni no Koushaku Reijou wa Tekikoku nite Kakusei Suru

204804.description:
After being fired from the bar where he worked, Asel has nothing. No family, no sponsor, no way out. It's at the height of his despair when Jinhyuk, a powerful alpha with a composed presence and dangerous kindness, offers him a hand. But the closer they get, the harder it becomes to walk away.

(Source: Manta)

204808.description:
Jin-Ha and Young-Jae of the group Runners High are known to be arch-rivals. Amidst this, an accident occurs where Jin-Ha, who has OCD, pushes Young-Jae. Rumors begin circulating among fans that the members don't get along, and with a dormitory-style self-produced content project looming, an emergency is declared... After much deliberation by the agency and manager, Jin-Ha and Young-Jae end up sharing a dorm room to prepare for the dorm-style self-produced content shoot! Will the two of them be okay...?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: The fourth story in Mago Creative's Idol Danpyeonseon (아이돌 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: The Symbiotic Relationship Between Insomnia and Mysophobia
失眠與潔癖的共生關係

title.native: 助けて!しゅくだい屋さん

204810.description:
When Sofia was a child, she promised her future to the prince. She only found out after they were no longer able to see each other, but he was now a distant memory. "I must somehow meet him one more time and put an end to my feelings." So she resolved to aim to become the top student at the magic school, which would give her an audience with the prince! But at that time, the prince was also...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Falling in Love Again with the Cursed Prince at the Magic School

title.native: 運命の呪われ王子と、魔法学校で再び恋に落ちる
title.romaji: Unmei no Noroware Ouji to, Mahou Gakkou de Futatabi Koi ni Ochiru

204811.description:
Hitman Lee Ja-Gyeong. His gun never misses, piercing the heart with pinpoint accuracy. It doesn't matter how despicable the target is. He took the job, killed, got paid, and that was the end of it. All he believed in was his skill and money. Then one day, a sudden, large-sum request came from a regular client. The condition for the $5 million payment was one thing: Kill Kang Il-Hyeon and retrieve one item from his safe. The target was ‘the son of a Korean gangster godfather’. Kang Il-Hyeon was a man with eyes as sharp as a snake's. Ja-Gyeong found himself slowly being strangled by the trap Kang had set, cornered...

“I heard a very interesting story while on a business trip to Hong Kong.”
“......”
“Aren't you curious? What that interesting story is?”
“Someone's trying to kill me. Right in my own house.”
“Explain it. I'll decide whether to believe you after hearing it.”

Can Ja-Gyeong kill Kang Il-Hyeon and complete the job? Or will he die a dog's death? The fight between men who wouldn't look out of place dying right now had begun.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: เหลี่ยมรักนักฆ่า

title.native: 落ち葉日記 -自宅調教編-
風紀委員長(巨乳)は積極的

204814.description:
Mika, a college student with a deep voice obsession, meets her handsome boss, Misaizu, at her part-time job. Hearing her idol's voice up close and personal, her rosy days begin. Misaizu develops an interest in Mika, who is obsessed with the things she loves, but his "face" is no match for Mika, who is only interested in 2D and can't tell the difference between handsome men in 3D. Through one twist and turn, the two become otaku buddies...!? A love comedy about a girl who's not used to love and a guy (who should be popular) whose love life isn't going the way he wants!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: I Love Your Voice So Much

204815.description:
1. Bijo to Yajuu: Gal to Kimoota 3rd (美女と野獣 〜ギャルとキモオタ〜 3rd); Comic Anthurium 2024-10
2. Bijo to Yaiuu: Gal to Kimoota 4th (美女と野獣 〜ギャルとキモオタ〜 4th); Comic Anthurium 2025-10
3. Futsutsuka Onaho (ふつつかオナホ); Comic Anthurium 2025-05
4. Kaerareru Watashi (変えられる私); Comic Anthurium 2024-05
5. Ikuzo Rikujoubu! (イくぞ陸上部!); Comic Anthurium 2024-03
6. Hatsujouki no Shishou ga "Kuru na" to Itta no ni (発情期の師匠が「来るな」と言ったのに); Comiket 105
7. Kimajime Kyouei Joshi, Sei ni Oboreru (生真面目競泳女子、性に溺れる); Comiket 102

204816.description:
What would you do if you met your first love again? I did it... Office worker Miri was introduced by a friend and by chance met her prince charming from her school days, Tachibana-senpai. Now an adult, he's become even more handsome... Tachibana's passionate approach leads to the two of them having sex that night. The next day, a new boss is assigned to the company she has transferred to. That boss is Tachibana, the man she had sex with the night before.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 大人の初恋始めました

204817.description:
Seon Jaehyeon keeps having dreams of a forgotten friend from middle school. But little does he know that friend is Han Dohoon, a college classmate who has heard some unsavory rumors about Jaehyeon. Believing these rumors as fact and mad that he’s been totally forgotten, Dohoon blackmails Jaehyeon into sleeping with him. But what starts as a mess of misunderstandings just might bring these two boys back to their short-lived and unfinished first love from all those years ago.

(Source: Tappytoon)

204818.description:
Miharu Adachi was having an affair with her boss, Teru Itou. Normally, it should not have been discovered by his wife, but Itou's wife, Yuno, approved of their relationship. In the midst of this love triangle, Miharu begins to think that if only Yuno were gone, she could make Teru hers.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

204819.description: Note: Published in Web Haishin Gekkan Tonari no Kininaru Oku-san Vol. 098

title.native: 人妻ヌーディストビーチ 熱砂の宴
title.romaji: Hitozuma Nudist Beach Nessa no Utage

204820.description:
Ayame Touka, the ace of the girl's volleyball team, is known as "Prince" because of her tall stature and handsome appearance. But this prince has a hobby she can't tell anyone about... She actually likes erotic TL novels! But there's one more thing he can't tell anyone about... She's a little interested in Asagi-senpai, a fellow library committee member... He's the only one who doesn't call her "Prince", and treats her like a girl... He's such a special person. Then, one day, she finds out Asagi-senpai's secret... The author of the TL novel that Ayame likes is Asagi-senpai!? The two secretive people begin to explore each other.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 姉の居ぬ間にハメたくて
あなたに嫌われたいんです
少子化対策マッチングアプリ

204824.description:
Ae-Jeong, always alone, discovers a moving doodle on her desk. It feels like she's made a friend. Ae-Jeong draws fun and necessary things for Doodle. But as the days go by, Doodle seems more and more listless. Finally, Ae-Jeong draws a "door" doodle... but what is the identity of the doodle that emerged from the door?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

204825.description:
"If I'm still single at thirty, let's get married!"

A playful promise made with a childhood friend in middle school. Time passes, and the year she turns thirty. Yeon-Hwa, who was about to marry her boyfriend since college, is shocked by the sudden announcement of their breakup. While walking down the street in a daze, she's hit by an oncoming car and wakes up to find her memories of the past ten years gone, her childhood friend acting as her guardian. Guardian? You're my guardian?

"Are we really married?!"

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Even If You Don't Have a Third

204826.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-254) was released on 14th November, 2025.

title.native: 自己開発リーマン、ギャルのおもちゃにされる
title.romaji: Jiko Kaihatsu Ryman, Gal no Omocha ni Sareru

204827.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-251) was released on 28th November, 2025.

204828.description:
Yang Deok-woo dreams of escaping bullying and becoming a normal high school student. However, contrary to his wishes, he finds himself embroiled in a fight on his first day of school and ultimately becomes the leader of Class 8. Will Yang Deok-woo, who has never been in a fight, be able to survive among these powerful individuals? A coming-of-age story of young people trying to become the best, and Yang Deok-woo's struggle for survival.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204829.description:
Avilia has been reincarnated as a villainous young lady, but is now immersed in her hobby of using herbs?! Avilia, the daughter of a count, remembers her past life as a Japanese woman after an accident. Her family is happy that the selfish Avilia has become normal! While she feels uneasy about this, she also realizes that she was quite terrible in her previous life.

Avilia remembers her past life, but in fact it's the "condemned villainous young lady" from a certain web novel! However, unaware of this, she devotes herself to finding a hobby in order to enjoy her "second life." When she finds out that her favorite herbs are considered weeds in the other world, she begins to immerse herself in making things using her knowledge from her past life, such as making herbal tea...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ライセット！～転生令嬢による異世界ハーブアイテム革命～
title.romaji: Reset!: Tensei Reijou ni Yoru Isekai Herb Item Kakumei

204830.description:
Male polytechnic honor student He Zhizhou and airheaded yet lovable female idiot Shen Xi had their bodies swapped in an accident. From the ever-present issues of misplaced youth to the supernatural chance encounters, the two of their lives have changed a lot from their past. He Zhizhou was forced to live in the female dorms, and Shen Xi had no choice but to adapt to the life of a man… This fresh new take on the school-life slice-of-life romcom is about to begin!

(Source: Coolmic)

204831.description:
As I was attacked by a demonic beast and my consciousness faded, I realized I had been reincarnated as Rail Vanstein, a mob character from the otome game "Seventh React." In the normal scenario, I should have died here, but for some reason I survived! What's more, Falk Sambur, the eldest son of the marquis and a popular childhood friend with a shady past, has transformed into an overly protective, doting, and sweet character! Has this disrupted the flow of the scenario? If it continues like this, won't everyone die in a bad ending...? I resolved to not let Rail's presence further disrupt the game's original scenario, but...

"I promise I'll always protect Rail."

Even after enrolling at Silvalence Academy, the setting of the game, Falk continues to spoil me. He somehow becomes friends with Sarah, the original protagonist, and strangely attracts attention from the other characters... Why doesn't everyone just follow the script?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: No One is Following the Scenario!

title.native: 誰もシナリオ通りに動いてくれないんですけど！
title.romaji: Dare mo Scenario Doori ni Ugoite Kurenain desu Kedo

204832.description:
"Since you've come this far, I'll make you glad you chose me."

Sakura is entrusted with a "mission" by a friend. That mission: to become Rosie, the protagonist of her beloved book, "The Fairy Princess Tale," and avert the tragedy that unfolds in this world and stop the repeating loop. But she fails the first time—she dies and returns to her hometown two years ago, and seeks help from her favorite character, her childhood friend and prince of a neighboring country, Yule. If possible, she wants to save him as well, as he is destined to die.

To save her loved one, the substitute young lady defies fate with all her might.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 成り代わり令嬢のループライン 繰り返す世界に幸せな結末を
title.romaji: Narikawari Reijou no Loop Line Kurikaesu Sekai ni Shiawase na Ketsumatsu wo

204833.description:
The unlucky female lead, Xiao Ai Ai, had mistakenly dated a cheating player, and even tragically passed away from getting struck by lightning. Unexpectedly, her soul traversed to ancient times and she became the pampered noble lady of the Marquis mansion. From there, she began her life of battling her vicious relatives while teasing the handsome war god Prince…

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Princess is a Goody Two-shoes
Princess Consort Is the White Lotus
Why Would the Princess Be Mischievous

204834.description:
Being reborn to be a little cowboy, the celestial emperor swears to make the enemies in his previous life suffer and pay the price. Unexpectedly, the body of this cowboy is completely weak?! Then he can only adopt another method, namely, rebuild his primordial spirit. Step by Step, with his most valuable treasure and memories, he rises abruptly and let everyone on the celestial world knows that the celestial emperor makes his comeback!

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Return of the Celestial Emperor

204835.description:
The craziest thing Stella has ever done is crawling into Uncle Luk's bed. Leon Luk thought it was just an accident, but Stella posts their intimate video online. The woman who fears nothing dares to challenge powerful Leon! "Stella, you will pay for what you've done!"

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Marriage Rippling Mr. Lu, Please Line Up to Chase His Wife

title.english: Rippling Marriage: The Way To Your Heart
title.native: 婚情荡漾：陆先生，追妻请排队
title.romaji: Hun Qing Dangyang: Lu Xiansheng, Zhui Qi Qing Paidui

204836.description:
Cynthia, the daughter of a margrave, grew up carefree in the vast countryside home to the kingdom's best army. One day, while enjoying her usual romantic novels, she attends her first evening party in the royal capital. There, she witnesses the story of a duke's son being condemned by a selfish princess and having his engagement broken off! Seeing a scene straight out of a novel, Cynthia bursts out and blurts out, "Then marry me!"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Margrave's Daydreamy Daughter Takes the Duke's Condemned Son Home

title.native: 田舎者にはよくわかりません ぼんやり辺境伯令嬢は、断罪された公爵令息をお持ち帰りする
title.romaji: Inakamono ni wa Yoku Wakarimasen Bonyari Henkyou Haku Reijou wa, Danzai Sareta Koushaku Reisoku wo Omochikaeri Suru

204837.description:
This isn't about a war between empires, nor is it about a journey across another world. Trust me. This isn't about leveling up or cultivation, either. The truth is, this is a very serious science fiction on saving the world. As the reader, you have to take it seriously, okay? No...? Alright, then...

This story features a certain nerd who suddenly became the head of an empire. Along the way, he ends up involuntarily adopting a bunch of little girls thanks to his fatherly aspects. This hilarious tale goes on between the ambitionless man with his regiment of powerful freeloaders who fell from the sky. Once again, for the record, this is a very serious story.

204838.description:
Bucky Dracula — the young heir to the vampire clan — wished to have the world's prettiest girl as his First Embrace! He thought he could finally fulfil his dream when he was exiled to the east. Nevertheless, never did he expect to encounter so many of them: wight, werewolf, exorcist, fox demon... "Arghh! An innocent vampire like me can only have a girl of destiny!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 热衷初拥美少女的德古拉子爵
title.romaji: Rezhong Chu Yong Mei Shaonü De Degula Zijue

204839.description:
That night, he takes her virginity and makes her his woman. Several charming princes and a restrained and calm humble maid. Will their meeting with her lead to a series of sweet romances or a huge crisis that destabilizes the whole country?

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Your Majesty, Please Let Me Go

204840.description:
A reincarnated former virgin aims to marry her oshi to avoid ruin!

Adelaide is reincarnated as the villainess in the world of her favorite otome game. Her efforts were in vain, and she met a tragic death as planned...or so she thought, but she's now thrust into a second loop! This time, she tries to marry her oshi, Siegward, to avoid ruin, but... What should she do about seduction and marriage!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: わたくしに恋してください！ ～ループ二回目の悪役令嬢ですが破滅回避のため誘惑します～
title.romaji: Watakushi ni Koishite Kudasai!: Loop Nikaime no Akuyaku Reijou desu ga Hametsu Kaihi no Tame Yuuwaku Shimasu

title.native: 本物の聖女じゃないとバレたのに、王弟殿下に迫られています
title.romaji: Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete Imasu

204842.description:
After being put to sleep for 100 years by a curse, harem maid Hayashi An wakes up in the arms of a handsome man who looks just like her fiance!? She changes her name to Kougyoku and takes on the harem's 100-year-old conspiracy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 目が覚めると百年後の後宮でした 後宮侍女紅玉
title.romaji: Megasameru to Hyakunen-go no Koukyuu deshita Koukyuu Jijo Kougyoku

204843.description:
Sterling faces a big challenge when Rihad, the Sheikh of Bakri, confronts her. Knowing that Sterling is pregnant with his little brother, Rihad has no choice but to make the baby his new heir. So he takes Sterling to Bakri and even convinces her to marry him so the baby's link to the royal family can't be doubted. Sterling goes along with Rihad's plans for her baby's sake and does her best to behave like a suitably convincing wife, even going on a honeymoon with Rihad... She has no interest in status or fortune for herself, but she cannot deny her interest in Rihad! Little does he know that Sterling is keeping a very big secret!

(Source: Renta!)

204844.description:
Amaya disappeared the day after her engagement ceremony. Her mother had called to warn her that her fiance, Sheikh Kavian, kept a harem of women. She was shocked and determined not to repeat her mother's painful experiences-her mother, unable to accept her husband's harem, had decided to forfeit a life of luxury to raise Amaya on her own. But six months after Amaya's disappearance, Kavian has tracked her down...and he's determined to show her the harem she fled.

(Source: Renta!)

204845.description:
When your big-tittied gamer friend pulls a "no balls" on you, she can't be upset if you unload a bucket of cum inside of her, can she?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: 友達だもんね?～巨乳女友達に迫られて朝までガチ生交尾!～
title.romaji: Tomodachi da Mon ne?: Kyonyuu Onna Tomodachi ni Semararete Asa made Gachi Nama Koubi!

204846.description:
Lin Zihan had been single. He had no luck pursuing any of the girls he had a crush on, not even his childhood friend. His future self appeared out of nowhere and charm Zihan's favorite girl. This future self of him called himself the Conqueror. He claimed he would change Zihan's life and the future of the four girls who were important to Zihan.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: The Future Me is a Conqueror
title.romaji: Weilai De Wo Shi Gonglüe Zhi Shen

title.native: 猫と男の子とその父親を買いました。
title.romaji: Neko to Otokonoko to Sono Chichioya wo Kaimashita.

204848.description:
"Care to buy a cheat code, Young Man?" "I heard Systems are all the rage recently. Give me a System." All my attributes were channeled toward strength after I bought a system cheat code by chance. Thus began my path to prove myself to the world using strength! Fierce, ancient beasts? Kill 'em with a punch! Monastic powerhouses? Kill 'em with a punch! I'll conjure up some miracles! Illness? I'll just destroy it with a punch! I'm Daniel, and I'm a living miracle!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Beginning With Sending to Die: Do Not Follow the Standard
Method to Cultivate to Be Immortal
I Added All My Attributes To Strength

title.native: 开局送挂：不按套路修仙
title.romaji: Kaiju Song Gua: Bu An Taolu Xiuxian

204849.description:
It's hard, but these two friends, now boyfriend and girlfriend, have managed to strike the perfect balance between playing games with each other and playing with each other's bodies. And as their relationship deepens, they begin escalating their sexual adventures even more!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: 続・友達だもんね?～巨乳女友達系カノジョとヤりまくり日常性活～
title.romaji: Zoku Tomodachi da Mon ne?: Kyonyuu Onna Tomodachi-kei Kanojo to Yarimakuri Nichijou Seikatsu

204850.description:
"I can't afford a coffin so I got you a box," a boy murmured to the wind, tears dried and eyes empty. Staring at the box carrying the dead baby girl sinking into the Holy River, the boy couldn't bear it anymore: "no! Let me see you one last time!"
Jumped into the Holy River, the boy mistakenly took another box, in which there was also a baby girl, alive, breathing, crying!
"Is God giving me another sister to pity me," the boy wiped his tears, "poor girl, you'll be my sister from now on..."
Yet, little did these two knew they were just pawns in someone's game....

(Source: MangaToon)

204851.description:
After being hit by a car, Xiao Ran wakes up to find herself back in the ancient time in the body of a homeless teen. As she sneaks into a restaurant to look for food, she encounters a pair of handsome men. When she runs into one of the pair - the more arrogant one later on, she realizes that she has witnessed him dealing unspeakable business and is therefore forced to become his servant. Xiao Ran goes on to find out that the gentler man of the pair is an old acquaintance, and her background is connected to the former royalty...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Really Love His Bad Temper

title.english: My Master is Fierce but Adorable
title.romaji: Shao Zhu Hao Xiong Wo Hao Ai

204852.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Kore ga Koi na Wake ga Nai: Shakaijin-hen (これが恋なワケがない 社会人編)" and the extra chapter "Kore wa Koi ni Fukumaremasu ka: Genzai (これは恋に含まれますか 現在)".
synonyms: これが恋なワケがない 社会人編
Kore ga Koi na Wake ga Nai: Shakaijin-hen
これは恋に含まれますか 現在
Kore wa Koi ni Fukumaremasu ka: Genzai

title.native: これが愛だとするのなら
title.romaji: Kore ga Ai da to Suru no Nara

204853.description:
Eva, eldest daughter of the Crozik Ducal House, is treated as worthless for being born without spirit magic. Orphaned at a young age and used as little more than a servant, Eva's fate worsens when her fiancé—the crown prince—has an affair with her stepsister. Framed and forced to choose between exile or servitude to her cruel sister, Eva chooses freedom. With loyal retainers at her side, she sets out for the neighboring kingdom of Foresty, determined to start a new life!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 精霊魔法が使えない無能だと婚約破棄されたので、義妹の奴隷になるより追放を選びました
title.romaji: Seirei Mahou ga Tsukaenai Munou dato Konyaku Haki sareta node, Gimai no Dorei ni Naru yori Tsuihou wo Erabimashita

204854.description:
Sword Saint Brise saved the country with his unique swordsmanship. At the end of his magnificent life, he is reincarnated as the country's youngest prince, still retaining his memories. He seeks freedom again and aspires to enter the elementary school of knight school. Even though he is an invincible swordsman, he unexpectedly fails!

"I came to get you."

He looks like a child, but inside he's an invincible former swordsman. In his reincarnation, he is picked up by his former disciple?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: Reincarnated. The Sword Saint Who Became a Shorty Prince to His Former Disciples I Don't Want My Former Disciple to Find Out.

title.native: 転生してショタ王子になった剣聖は、かつての弟子には絶対にバレたくないっ
title.romaji: Tensei shite Shota Ouji ni Natta Kensei wa, Katsute no Deshi ni wa Zettai ni Baretakunai

204855.description:
Yufilia is the daughter of a count. She has never felt any love from her family, and they always put her little sister first. Yufilia decided to just live her life with no one to count on. One night, while finding solace on her balcony, a small, injured owl lands in her palms. Then, for some reason, the next day she receives a passionate proposal from the neighboring emperor?! "At last. Surely, all this time, I've been searching for you since the day I was born." With his melting gaze and sweet words, the emperor ruthlessly eliminates those who try to stand in the way of their romance. But isn't this love a bit too overwhelming?! A Cinderella story about the strongest marriage between a mistreated girl and an emperor!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Owl and His Fated Mate

204856.description:
When her younger brother Sennett is involved in an accident, Jewel rushes to the Canmore household to ask for help with the surgery costs. In exchange for his support, the Marquis asks her to become his nominal wife. A few years later, the Marquis dies, and his will states that Jewel must "live married to his son, Blake, for two years." If this is not achieved, all of his assets will go to Jewel. Jewel interprets this as a transition period for the new Marquis, but Blake dismisses her as a wicked woman after money and refuses to listen...!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 侯爵家の悪妻は契約です
title.romaji: Koushaku-ka no Akusai wa Keiyaku desu

204857.description:
Colette is an accountant working in the royal capital's commoner tax department. She's been demoted by her boss and ends up becoming the personal accountant for Prince Radis, who is rumored to be misanthropic! She reluctantly accepts the position for a limited period, but the prince, with a devilish smile on his face, tells her that he's searching for a child who sneaked into the castle ten years ago.

Is that me? Surely, if I'm found out, I'll be executed!? I don't want to die, so I'll quit my job as the prince's accountant before he finds out!!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 王子様の訳あり会計士　なりすまし令嬢は処刑回避のため円満退職したい！
title.romaji: Ouji-sama no Wakeari Kaikeishi Narisumashi Reijou wa Shokei Kaihi no Tame Enman Taishoku shitai!

204858.description:
Shirai Kasumi, the daughter of a rural nobleman, is a maid in the harem serving Seiran, a consort candidate for the Chaoyang Kingdom. On a full moon night in mid-spring, while trying to save Emperor Tenyou from falling into the harem pond, they both fall into the pond, and their bodies are swapped! Until they can carry out the proposed solution of "trying to fall into the pond together again on the next full moon night," they must actually live with their bodies swapped...

After accidentally becoming emperor (on the outside), Shirai Kasumi finds out that the consort candidates are underestimating Tenyou because the empress, Hidemasa, is too strong. In an attempt to rectify this, Shirai Kasumi devises a "Plan to Make the Empress Grateful," but...!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 身代わり皇帝の憂鬱～後宮の侍女ですが、入れ替わった皇帝に全てを押しつけられています～
title.romaji: Migawari Koutei no Yuuutsu: Kokyuu no Jijo desu ga, Irekawatta Koutei ni Subete wo Oshitsukerareteimasu

204859.description:
"I don't want to get married!"

The selfish son of a viscount proposed to Chiara, the daughter of a jeweler, and she ran away. When a commoner is proposed to by a nobleman, she has no right to refuse. After desperately fleeing from the son who was pursuing her, Chiara finally arrives at a church where she meets a handsome boy named Snow. He says he is looking for a husband to participate in the ceremony as an adult nobleman. Encouraged by the bishop to marry him, and cornered by the son, Chiara decides to marry Snow, even if it means getting divorced --!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 注文の多い魔法使い 契約花嫁はおねだり上手な最強魔術師に溺愛されています!?
title.romaji: Chuumon no Ooi Mahoutsukai: Keiyaku Hanayome wa Onedari Jouzu na Saikyou Majutsushi ni Dekiai sareteimasu!?

204860.description:
Emma, ​​a human, has a close friend in the beastman aristocracy, the Serpent Duke. She works as a potion maker, but the Serpent Duke has an unexpected request. It's a request for a strategy to help Lyle, a sacred unicorn beastman and royal guard knight, overcome his fear of women...!? They begin their training, but they start by holding hands and even interact like lovers! ...Don't you think their physical contact is a little too intense? A courtship love fantasy begins with a lesson with the unicorn beastman knight!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

204861.description:
His Royal Highness the Crown Prince is obsessed with a certain Baron's daughter. When Marion receives a letter from the Crown Prince announcing his engagement to her, she also hears these disturbing rumors. So she sets out on a journey with her handsome servant, Licht, to uncover the truth. However, with the blood of the cursed Holy Noble running through her veins, one misfortune after another befalls Marion, and her days do not go as planned. Will they be able to reach the royal capital safely? A love fantasy woven by a young lady loved by disaster and a handsome servant, with a difficult future ahead.♡

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: The Misfortune Follows the Unlucky Lady

title.native: 災厄令嬢の不条理な事情 婚約者に私以外のお相手がいると聞いてしまったのですが!
title.romaji: Saiyaku Reijou no Fujouri na Jijou Konyakusha ni Watashi Igai no Oaite ga Iru to Kiite shimatta no desu ga!

204862.description:
On the way home from a workplace drinking party, Mazumi bumps into a boy. Wanting to get away from the situation as quickly as possible, he lies and says the boy is her relative, which leads to the two becoming involved... A cold-hearted young man and a boy who tends to expect things - their days begin to take on color after this chance encounter.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 戦国立志編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Sengoku Risshi-hen

204866.description:
Fifteen years ago, Alfred failed to protect his childhood friend from the hands of pirates. Consumed by regret, he dedicated his life to the sea and rose to the rank of a naval lieutenant. But one day when he boards a merchant vessel under siege by pirates, he finds himself crossing swords with the very childhood friend he swore to protect, Lilian. Thus begins a romance of misunderstanding between a straight-laced naval officer and a tomboy pirate!

(Source: Manga UP!)

204867.description:
Haruto Harukawa, a 28-year-old working as an assistant producer for TV dramas and aspiring to become a main producer, is suddenly put in charge of planning a brand-new tokusatsu hero show.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

204870.description:
Georgina is still hurt that her cousin stole her boyfriend, and now they're getting married. That's why she hires an escort, so she doesn't have to go to their wedding alone. The guy who shows up at her door is a charming, sexy man named Callum. The wedding is painful for Georgina... She has a few drinks too many and ends up sleeping with Callum! It's not like her to be so casual. And to make matters worse, when she goes back to work, she finds out her new boss is none other than Callum...and he's already made up his mind that she's bad news!

(Source: Renta!)

204871.description:
An accident had put an end to Andy's ballet career, but she was still celebrating her twenty-third birthday with her sister and brother-in-law. And that's when famous billionaire Darius Sterne, a man followed by dark rumors, approached them and asked her out. Andy has devoted her life to ballet and has never been in a relationship. After her accident left scars on her body, she can't imagine being intimate with anyone. Knowing that Darius lives in a totally different world from her own, she decides to let him take her out just once. But when Darius kisses her, she wishes it could never end...

(Source: Renta!)

204872.description:
Gillian's boyfriend is the sexy crown prince of the wealthy European country of Volyarus. It's been seven months since they fell in love and she believes that he's about to propose to her, but after a passionate kiss and a night in bed, she's shocked by what he tells her. He's not proposing...he wants to break up! "It's all in your test results-I cannot marry a woman who cannot give me an heir." He then leaves and Gillian realizes that he must never have loved her. So what is she to do when she learns she's carrying a small life inside her?

(Source: Renta!)

204873.description:
Alex promised a tycoon he would investigate whether his long-lost granddaughter, Rosie, is a worthy heir. When he met Rosie while undercover, he felt a tremulous excitement that he had never experienced before. While Alex tried to get closer to Rosie and take care of her, Rosie fell in love with him. Their relationship seemed to be going well, but then Rosie realized Alex's true motives. Shocked and devastated, she has to ask herself if her first love is over.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: A Ring to Secure His Heir

204874.description:
Queen Elena of the island kingdom of Thallia is set to marry the new sheikh of Kadar. However, as soon as she sets foot in his country, she is captured by a mysterious man named Khalil. He fixes Elena with a golden-eyed glare and declares that he is the rightful ruler of Kadar. He then takes Elena to a desert village, where she is touched by his kindness. Things aren't always what they seem, he tells her, and she can sense the truth in his words. But though Elena's heart has begun to open to Khalil, she believes that to him she's nothing more than a pawn he can use to take his throne.

(Source: Renta!)

204875.description:
Paige is working on her next creation in her workshop when a strange man appears and shouts, "Fire!" Thanks to him-her new Russian neighbor her house is saved from burning to the ground. Stefan is so sexy that her heart starts pounding, but she's not one to fall in love, preferring to live in solitude. Then he begins coming by her house for English lessons day after day... And before she knows it, he's become a part of her life!

(Source: Renta)

204876.description:
At her close friend's wedding, Alanna is reunited with Niccolo. He's a famous businessman now, and ten years ago they shared a passionate kiss. In their hearts they both wanted more, but neither followed those desires. This time, however, along with a burgeoning business relationship, Niccolo pursues his feelings for her. But Alanna has struggled financially since they first met and once had to work as a nude model to get by. The job left a scar on her heart, and ever since then she's been hesitant to pursue romance. How will Niccolo react when he learns about her past?

(Source: Renta!)

204877.description:
There's a reason Domini, a temporary secretary, keeps turning down a permanent offer of work from her boss, Jack. He's far too attractive! She doesn't think she can remain professional if the arrogant and confident playboy keeps calling her name with that sexy voice of his. But Jack appreciates the value of her work and counteroffers with an irresistible contract. She agrees to the contract renewal on the condition that they keep their relationship professional, but the moment she signs the contract, the rules seem to fly out the window!

(Source: Renta!)

204878.description:
Waitress Joleen should be in ecstasy after being proposed to by a multimillionaire. It's her chance to break free of her struggles after losing her mother and working to put herself through night classes. However, she's unable to commit herself to a marriage with him. He's from a completely different world; does he even love her? He invites her to come to his house to meet his family, and she accepts his invitation. But a thoroughly unfriendly man comes to pick her up. It turns out he's Jake, the multimillionaire's younger brother. And even while he's disparaging her, saying she isn't good enough to join his family, Joleen can feel an electric connection with Jake!

(Source: Renta!)

204879.description:
After her father died, Edwina's uncle was determined to marry her off to a strange earl. Without any other options, she decided to dress like a boy, run away and call herself Ed. But out on her own, she fell into the hands of a man who forced her into pickpocketing on the streets of London. One day she's saved by a handsome gentleman named Adam and taken to his mansion. When Adam sees that Ed is actually a beautiful woman, he's surprised at first but, taken in by her charms, he decides to make her an offer...

(Source: Renta)

204880.description:
"Why are you kissing me so gently...?"

One day, the academy's only female knight, Marquis Lea Emmanuel, suddenly realizes that she has been reincarnated as a villainous female knight from an alternate-world time-learning novel she was obsessed with in her previous life. To avoid a death ending, she must accept her fiancé, but Lea has no immunity to men, either in her previous or current life. Just as she is in despair, Albert, the ruthless knight and Lea's rival, who was her favorite character in her previous life, appears. For some reason, he offers to be Lea's sex practice partner! Confused by Albert's gentle kisses and caresses, Lea gradually gives in to his body. The ruthless knight's melting affection is unstoppable! A sexy love romance begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 冷酷騎士の溺愛指導 -10年分の甘い愛にとろけ中-
title.romaji: Reikoku Kishi no Dekiai Shidou: 10-Nenbun no Amai Ai ni Toroke-chuu

204881.description:
Martina, a lion beastman, works as a policewoman, protecting the peace in the city and living with her beloved family in the orphanage she runs. One day, she rescues a "human" child from a terrorist organization and ends up adopting him... A story of human, beastman, and family love.

(Source: Mangabox, translated)

204882.description:
When Jiang Ru realizes she has been pulled into a novel and become the villainess, she has no way out but to complete any bizarre prompts a nasty system instructs her to do. The system, which has failed countless hosts before, is now forcing Jiang Ru to provoke Li Yaoche, the protagonist of this very novel, as much as she can in order to complete her mission. However, while Jiang Ru grasps the opportunity to flirt with Li Yaoche's harem, she somehow ended up becoming his love interest.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: She Became the Sickly Prince's First Love
She Became the White Moonlight of the Sick King
She Becomes The Yandere King's White Moonlight

title.english: Becoming the Lover of a Twisted Tyrant
title.native: 她成了病娇君王的白月光
title.romaji: Ta Chengle Bing Jiao Junwang De Bai Yueguang

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 感動スポーツ編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Kandou Sports-hen

204885.description:
A special two-page one-shot commemorating the 55th anniversary of Mitsuru Adachi sensei's career.
Released in Weekly Shonen Sunday 50/2025.

title.native: 行列のできるあだち先生

204887.description:
In the fall of his second year of college, Urata was sulking away, unable to achieve anything. Then, he decided to attend a live concert featuring Yamada, a lively girl from his university, and her band. There, he saw a completely different side of her than he had been in college. The music she played resonated deeply in his stomach. A youthful rock story of impulse and passionate singing!

(Source: Mangabox, translated)

title.native: シューゲイザーの彼女

204888.description:
He is a martial arts master, internationally renowned, a god in martial arts, capable of killing a person within ten steps; he is a knowledgeable antique expert, skilled in gambling on stones and appreciating paintings, with a collection that can rival a nation's wealth; he is a highly reputed master in the esoteric arts, able to discern feng shui, good at detecting good and bad omens, equally respected by Buddhism and Taoism. Furthermore, he is a medical expert, the king of scouting, and a genius investor! His name is Zhang Jun. With a fortunate occurrence, he received Buddha’s eye relic and from then on, he has appreciated women from all over the world!

(Source: MangaToon)

204889.description:
The human world was dominated by unknown terror. To survive, a group of awakened people chose to fight back. Yi Lin, an unlucky guy who hadn't had the chance to be the hero, was betrayed after he managed to kill the final boss. But he gets reborn with the abilities of a villainous boss. The once ordinary man becomes the mortal enemy of countless gods and demons. Hey, you guys over there, it's too late to kneel now.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I'm Truly Not the Villainous Big Shot

204890.description:
As a child, Laura appeared on the poster of a nonprofit, and her angelic looks captured the public's imagination. Now she's an adult, and her beauty has captured the heart of millionaire Samual Bishop. But he's overprotective of her. He treats Laura so delicately, she feels like a porcelain doll. She can't tell if it's love or pity that he feels for her...so she asks for a separation. Though she loves Samuel, she doesn't know if there's a future for them. While working through her concerns, Laura slips and hits her head and suffers a spell of amnesia...taking her back to the time when she and Samuel were madly in love!

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Kieta Kioku to Ai no Kizuna

204891.description:
On the year I arrived on this continent, I ascended as the Sword Saint at 20 thanks to my unparalleled talent and extraordinary opportunities... Eh? Am I the protagonist? You've got it all wrong—look over there. Yes, that blonde narcissist is this story's real protagonist... Demon Lord? She pulled out at the start. As for a harem... Do you think a character like me has that sort of interest?! Ahem! Anyway, this is the tale of a disenchanted and unambitious Sword Saint...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: My Life as the Retired Hero

204892.description: Lori is the most popular drag queen at a nightclub in the city. The other queens call her "Mama Lori", and she herself thinks of them as her daughters. One night, Lori receives the news of her mother's passing from her hometown. And so, using the inheritance money from her mother who abandoned her, Lori sets a plan in motion...?!

title.native: ペパロニ・ヴァンパイア

204893.description:
What happens when you're caught off guard and thrust into a beauty game with its own psyche, where doing skincare increases buff, applying makeup increases attack power? Wu Xiaowei's goal is very simple: stay alive, go through the levels quickly, pass missions, purchase a large variety of lipsticks and eyeshadows that she cannot afford in the real world, as well as apply skincare products from luxurious brands. Limited items are not rejected but welcomed. The more discontinued limited items she owns, the better. She wants to survive in style in this fantasy world.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: The Ultimate Guide to Becoming a Successful Makeup Artist
title.romaji: Shengshi Zhuang Niang: Zhuang Zhe Gonglüe

204894.description:
Kim Sang-an is a cold-blooded loan shark. When his younger sister, a schoolteacher, takes her own life after relentless bullying from her students, he becomes the homeroom teacher of those very students to collect the price of her life. A merciless loan shark who will collect his debts even if it means descending into hell and a class of devil-like students... A vicious, twisted teacher-student relationship.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: หนี้เดือดเลือดนักเรียน

204895.description:
Two families who loathe each other to the core: Vermonte and Temnes. Clodel becomes the sacrificial offering for a forced reconciliation, marrying Kaian, the Duke of Temnes. “So you’re a bride unwelcomed by Temnes. Know your place and walk in on your own feet.” Kaian treats her coldly, as the heir of a family locked in long-standing hostility. “How admirable. Selling yourself to a man from your enemy’s house because of starving children.” For him, it was an unwanted marriage. For her, it was a marriage she chose. Clodel endured the humiliation poured upon her— she had not come here ignorant of what awaited her. Between the two, a fragile bond of husband and wife begins to take root. Gradually, he grows obsessed with Clodel, and she finds a reason to live in Kaian. But a shallow, unstable relationship is easily shattered and ruined. “It’s disgusting—mixing such filthy blood. It’s not like you can split a child in half.” Upon learning her husband’s true feelings, Clodel leaves him behind.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204896.description:
No matter where I am, the goal remains the same! A yankii high school girl competes in a street fighting game in another world.

(Source: Gakken, translated)

title.native: ブッチ組 ～夜露死苦異世界 我等真武親友 悪鬼滅殺仏血義礼組
title.romaji: Bucchigumi: Yoroshiku Isekai Warera Mabudachi Akkimessastsu Bucchigiregumi

204897.description: Shi Guang and Xia Ling, one is a young staff and the other is a graduate student. For these two who are halfway into society, the new cohabitation life is both fresh and full of unknowns...

204898.description:
Belle’s been reborn into a romance novel. Not as the heroine or the villainess, no, Belle has simply transmigrated into a pretty background character… at the exact moment the villain is about to kill her! Is her romantic new life over before it’s even begun?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I'm Not the Villain's White Moonlight!

title.english: I Won't Be the Villain's Only Lover
title.native: 我才不做反派的白月光！
title.romaji: Wo Cai Bu Zuo Fan Pai De Bai Yue Guang!

204899.description:
Reality and game worlds merge as "Apocalypse" engulfs the Earth. Zhang Yi, an avid gamer, experiences betrayal leading to his demise after 8 years in-game. Karma favors him with a second chance, allowing him to regress but now equipped with knowledge and experience from his past life. Armed and ready, he seeks vengeance, leveraging his insights for an upper hand. Yet, as revenge nears, he stumbles upon a conspiracy far greater than he anticipated, hinting at battles beyond personal vendettas.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Rely on Cheat to Hunt Gods
I Rely on Plug-ins to Hunt Gods

204900.description:
The gloomy days of school, the lonely days after the death of his beloved wife, and a life of commuting between work and home suddenly begin to shine like the sky after the rain.

This collection contains 10 short stories filled with special moments in life.

1. Miniature to Bench (ミニチュアとベンチ)
2. Geko no Soul Food (下戸のソウルフード)
3. Photographer (フォトグラファー)
4. Shousan to Kyuutarou (正三と九太郎)
5. Kitsune to Turkey (キツネとターキー)
6. Gekou (下校)
7. Yoshinoyama no Hanashi (吉野山の話)
8. Yorimichi (よりみち)
9. Hangyonin no Koro (半魚人の頃)
10. Kae-chan no Atarashii Tomodachi (かえちゃんの新しい友達)

(Source: Magazine House, translated)

title.native: あたらしいともだち かわじろう短編集
イキガミとドナー 二人のイキガミ
title.romaji: Ikigami to Donor: Futari no Ikigami

204902.description:
When a multimillionaire is injured in a car accident, Sam ends up taking care of him. Xander is an international entrepreneur, one of the Sterne brothers and an infamous playboy with shining blond hair. Sam is a single mother who's survived a tremendous ordeal. She promises herself that she'll never do something so stupid as falling in love with a multimillionaire playboy. But will Sam be able to keep her cool when faced with his gorgeous body? Her resolve crumbles when his kindness and overwhelming charm shine through...

(Source: Renta!)

204903.description:
Vere Tolladine, a successful businessman, needed help. He'd been taking care of his late brother's wife and her children and couldn't keep doing it alone. So Fabienne became his live-in nanny. Vere is unfailingly kind to everyone...except Fabienne! She can't understand why Vere treats her differently, but she can't stop thinking about him. Fabienne has conflicting feelings about Vere that become even more complicated when she realizes that Vere is in love with his sister-in-law...

(Source: Renta!)

204904.description: Helen, who lost her parents when she was young, was raised by her aunt. However, her aunt’s business has gone bankrupt and now they’re desperate. They receive an invitation from Earl Bridgemere, the patriarch of Aunt Bella’s family, to his annual Christmas party. Aunt Bella usually declines, but she has no choice this year.
