The two decide to attend the party to ask the earl for help, but upon their arrival Aunt Bella collapses. Helen seeks assistance from an attendant…who turns out to be Earl Bridgemere himself!

204905.description:
In the 1990s, a horrific case of abuse occurred in a "child welfare institution" that was supposed to protect children! Daily assaults in the name of "discipline" and horrific sexual abuse that took place night after night... It was a hellish garden called Eden. This work is a manga adaptation of the real-life experiences of a man who spent his childhood and teenage years in a child welfare institution. The heartbreaking cries of children who fell prey to the dark desires of adults will shake your heart in this shocking and controversial work!

(Source: Nyancomic, translated)

title.native: エデンの子～地獄の児童養護施設～
title.romaji: Eden no Ko: Jigoku no Jidou Yougo Shisetsu

title.native: 異世界魔法少女ラジカル☆ハルナ

204907.description:
One day, Alyssa, a stubborn medical intern, reluctantly finds herself on a date with meddlesome coworker and famous consulting doctor Seb, who also happens to be a playboy. There are rumors that Seb never goes on more than one date with a woman. He's exactly the type of man Alyssa hates the most. During their dinner, Alyssa finds herself the subject of Seb's passionate gaze and talented flirting, and despite her resolve, her heart skips a beat. What is she thinking? Does she really want to relive the mistake she made five years ago?

(Source: Renta!)

204908.description:
"If you lose the bet, you'll become my lover."

Her former lover, Chase, now fueled by revenge, approaches Kate with a merciless game. Memories of her youth ten years ago are resurrected in her mind. Her powerful father was opposed to their relationship and, one regretful night, he used cruel, underhanded tactics to run Chase out of town. And now he's back. He's more handsome than ever and is wealthy enough to hold the town in the palm of his hand. He's here to take everything away from Kate. Hated by the man she's still in love with, what will become of her?

(Source: Renta!)

204909.description:
Shayla attended a party organized by the Dante clan...not to celebrate with them, but to find ways to exploit them. While there, she came across a marvelously beautiful man-Draco. In no time, he and Shayla were in bed together. Shayla fulfilled her wish of giving up her virginity to someone wonderful. However, she has yet to notice that she is falling in love...and Draco, her lover, is destined to lead her either to heaven or to hell.

(Source: Renta!)

204910.description: A collection of absurd and often aimless SF stories.

204911.description:
The rounin, Kuchiki, and the young girl, Hibari, live together. Having lost her parents and facing the world alone, Hibari finds solace in Kuchiki's caring presence and begins to regain her smile and strength. However, a casual remark from a boy named Matsunosuke, who lost his mother in a fire, triggers memories of her father's past sins in Hibari's heart.

Can two souls burdened with wandering hearts find a way to live for tomorrow? This is a story of human compassion and emotions in the streets of old Edo.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

204912.description:
Uncomplicated rock 'n' roll for the complicated heart! The curtain rises on this remote island, where a tale of youthful band life begins.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

204915.description:
Cindy, a secretary, is in love with her workaholic boss, Kyle. But to him, Cindy is nothing more than a trustworthy coworker. He forgot her birthday and she knows she'll never turn his head with her looks. But maybe someday a Kyle will fall for her intellect. Cindy's friends decide to help her out, and so for her birthday they get her a makeover. Transformed on the surface, Cindy is still the same woman she always was, but Kyle's reaction to the change leaves Cindy shocked!

(Source: Renta!)

204916.description:
Samira, the princess of Jazir, was just reunited with her first love, Tarik, at a charity party. He's now the recently divorced sultan of Al-Sarath. Tarik introduces Samira to his twins and she is immediately smitten. This might be her first and last chance to be a mother, since she's been told she can never get pregnant again. So Samira dared to suggest a marriage of convenience, for the sake of the children...and Tarik's expression changed completely!

(Source: Renta!)

204917.description:
With a baby in her arms, Marian finally arrives at Bellfield Hall. There are terrible rumors about the master of the mansion, Heywood Denshaw. They say that, as the despot of the town, he snatched the manor and the mill away from the person who was supposed to inherit them. When she finally arrives, the master and housekeeper come out together. Marian is captivated by his eyes-they're as cold as the winter sky. Yet Marian must somehow get him to give her a job!

(Source: Renta!)

204918.description:
"I have something I want you to help me with. Let's have a fake marriage."

Alex can't believe her ears when Philippe says this to her. He had saved her at the beach a few days earlier, but he was a guest staying in the hotel she worked at and they were virtual strangers. However, Alex is hurt when she finds out that she was betrayed by her fiance, so she goes along with Philippe's clever trick, marrying him and being whisked off to France. She has no idea that she will encounter pain in the form of love in that extravagant chateau...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 薬屋のママ系お兄さんは村人たちのミルクバー
title.romaji: Kusuriya no Mama-kei Onii-san wa Murabito-tachi no Milk Bar

204920.description:
Leigh agreed to take care of her seven-year-old niece, Amy, after the sudden death of her older sister and her husband. She took a break from studying graphic design at university to work and pay down her sister's debts, but the bank finally put the house in foreclosure. Leigh was devastated and decided to seek help from Amy's real father, Nicholas Kendall, the CEO of a major corporation who had a one-night stand with Amy's sister. At first, he doubted that Amy was his, but he changed his mind soon after meeting her. All Leigh wanted was to borrow a little bit of money, but instead Nicholas insisted that Leigh and Amy move into his house!

(Source: Renta!)

204921.description:
Single mother Carrie has been sick for a while, and now her child has been taken away from her by the Child Protection Services. At a loss, she thinks of her son's father, Dominic Savage. She fell in love with him eight years ago, but she left him after learning that he had a fiancee. She believed she was just a plaything to him. But she has no choice but to rely on his wealth and power now. In desperation, she visits Dominic and is taken aback by his proposition. He says he wants her to live with him...in the same house with his wife!

(Source: Renta!)

204922.description:
In his will Megan's father had stipulated that she must marry within two years and have a child or forfeit ownership of the ranch. So now she must find a husband, and quick! She works up her courage to meet her childhood friend Nathan Bravo. Though they grew up together, he left town to work as a veterinarian in the city long ago. Now, twelve years later, Megan is determined to ask him to marry her!

(Source: Renta!)

204923.description:
What did the older sister of two sisters ask of a demon who will grant any wish in exchange for her life...? A thrilling comedy about the cohabitation of two sisters, the most powerful demon and two troubled sisters!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: アクマは姉妹とアレをする
title.romaji: Akuma wa Shimai to Are wo Suru

204924.description:
The official prequel manga to the hit game Assassin's Creed Shadows!

Caught in a secret war between the Templar Order and the Assassin Brotherhood, feudal Japan becomes a battleground for Assassins and shinobi alike!

The machinations of the Templar Order have increased their influence all over Japan, but hope has come to Iga. An Assassin and his young apprentice have arrived to the birthplace of ninjutsu, seeking aid from legendary shinobi like Hattori Hanzo and Momochi Sandayu in their fight for justice. There is one way to stem the tide of the Templar: one must live in the darkness, but serve the light. Assassin's Creed Shadows is the story of the ninja who protect Japan.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.english: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Tales of Iga
title.native: アサシンクリードシャドウズ 伊賀の物語
title.romaji: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Iga no Monogatari

204925.description:
Demon.

Though it signifies the devil, Satan, and all evil in the world, here it's just a stable, high-paying, popular job. Woo-Hyuk, a convenience store part-timer struggling daily to pass the Incubus exam, held only once a year, one day receives a startling proposal from Si-Woon, his long-time, ever-helpful friend...

“You want to pass the incubus exam that badly? Then practice with me.”

A sex class begins for incubus exam prep... It feels good, but between friends... Is this okay...?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

204926.description:
Yuri Honda, an author, suddenly finds herself reincarnated into her own story. The worst part? She's Yuliana, an unfortunate character who meets a tragic end. In order to avoid the same ending as in her novels, she tries to gain the favor of her father, Lambert, also known as the "Marquis of Ice" for his chilly demeanor. For some reason, instead of hating her, he starts pampering her - feeding her sweets, and holding her on his lap! On top of that, the brother who should despise her doesn't seem to at all, and her magic master also seems to spoil her?!

(Source: Manga Mirai)

title.english: I Want to be Pampered by the Marquis of Ice!～Reincarnated as a girl with a depressing story～
title.native: 氷の侯爵様に甘やかされたいっ！～シリアス展開しかない幼女に転生してしまった私の奮闘記～@COMIC
title.romaji: Koori no Koushaku-sama ni Amayakasaretai!: Serious Tenkai shika Nai Youjo ni Tensei shiteshimatta Watashi no Funtouki @comic

204928.description:
Desperate to support his daughter, single father Su-Jong accepts a lucrative offer from his former college hoobae, Wu-Min, to participate in a secret research trial. Blinded by the massive payout, Su-Jong signs the papers without reading the details. But the experiment isn't just medical—it's transformative. Waking up to discover his physical anatomy has been altered, Su-Jong realizes he has unknowingly contracted his body away to Wu-Min's private experiments.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: Pay attention to the contract clauses

204929.description:
Evan became a tutor in the renowned Frost family household. The Frost family had two sons: the eldest, Theodore, and the second son, Darren. While teaching the brothers, Evan fell in love with Theodore, and after becoming an adult, he remained by his side as his aide.

“I love you, Evan.”

'Damn it, I liked him first.'

But the second son, Darren, who secretly harbored feelings for Evan, grew jealous of their affection.

“Just you wait. I'll take him away from you, no matter what it takes.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.

204930.description:
Chae-Sung is a ruthless loan shark who has seen every kind of debtor, until Byun Yu-On. Flawless on paper, Yu-On never misses a payment, no matter how brutal the terms. The kind of client anyone would want. But there is something wrong with him. The way his gaze lingers on Chae-Sung, quiet, unwavering, and far too intent. It is not just business to him, and that is exactly the problem. So Chae-Sung makes up his mind to break that obsession and cut Yu-On out of his life, no matter what it takes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204931.description:
A genius manga artist who left an immense impact during his brief career spanning less than two years in the early 90s. The complete works of Ryuuzou Takagi, sought after by manga connoisseurs, are published for the first time commercially in tankobon format!

Who was Ryuuzou Takagi? He was born in Aichi Prefecture in 1968. In 1991, he was honored as a runner-up in Kodansha's Chiba Tetsuya Award with his future highly anticipated, yet he passed away prematurely in 1993. His works published in Kodansha's seinen manga magazines garnered high praise and resonance at the time, profoundly influencing the world of New Wave manga primarily from the 1990s onward.

Due to the vividness of his work and the brevity of his career, Ryuuzou Takagi has become something of a legendary figure among manga connoisseurs. However, his works were never commercially published in tankobon format (the only collected works published were the posthumous Takagi Ryuuzou Sakuhinshuu, distributed to associates and some readers). Despite the high praise for his work, accessing it remained extremely difficult.

Therefore, in response to numerous requests, we are now compiling the works left behind by Ryuuzou Takagi into a single A5-sized volume for publication. For this book's production, we have re-scanned all works based on Mr. Takagi's original manuscripts. We have prepared new layouts featuring higher resolution than at the time of their original publication.

Please take this opportunity to experience the legacy of the little-known genius manga artist, Ryuuzou Takagi.

(Source: Fukkan, translated)

title.native: 高木りゅうぞう作品集 ツイステッド

204932.description:
This original work is inspired by the classic supernatural tale, Banqiao San Niangzi of the Taiping Guangji (Extensive Records of the Taiping Era) written in 10th century China. The evolution of civilizations and history is driven by fear.

Spanning over two thousand years, our story follows a sorceress named Madame Dolly and her companion, Yeli Feitian, as they are relentlessly pursued by the Three Divine Envoys and Puyin the warrior monk, while getting entangled in a series of unimaginable societal upheavals. As times change, so do the things that she fears—just as they do for all humans. She comes to realize that fear is merely a blockage of emotion, a threshold one must cross before reaching happiness. Only by overcoming fear can emotions flow freely once more. After experiencing millenniums of love and hate, Madame Dolly's journey will ultimately culminate in the divine and demonic battles of the centuries to come.

(Source: Taiwan Comic City)

204933.description:
A world shattered by an earthquake. A girl seeks to identify her psychopathic father, a man pursues him, and a killer revered as a god.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204934.description:
His Majesty suffers from dysmenorrhea! Dysmenorrhea is a condition where one cannot dress or undress. But His Majesty can be dressed by me, a mere court lady, neither a chambermaid nor a servant !?

"There is only one girl in this palace who can undress me when I am mad and put my clothes back on. What do you think? Who do you think it is? Sosa, answer me."

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: As Night Falls Upon the Autumn River
เหยื่อรักยัยตัวร้าย

title.english: The Hare Hops on Festival Days
title.native: 脱兎は祭りの日に跳ねる
title.romaji: Datto wa Matsuri no Hi ni Haneru

204939.description:
One day, Shin Jin-Ho and his coworkers were suddenly swept into another world by an earthquake... It turned out this other world was identical in every detail to the webtoon drawn by his older brother. His brother, a long-time unknown writer, had become frustrated by repeated failures with his next projects, grew pessimistic about his own work, and vanished somewhere... Only Jin-Ho, who knew the worldview and story of his brother's webtoon inside out, could properly navigate this other world. Thus, Jin-Ho sets out on a journey with his coworkers, aiming to achieve two goals at once: escaping this other world to return to their original one, and discovering the whereabouts of his vanished brother.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: よるべのないしのんちゃん

204941.description:
"Could it really be that I can see it...? I've always wanted to see Chief Honjo's naughty side...!"

The idea of ​​her voice making men's dicks hard is so much fun -- that's what motivated Mai Suzusuki to become a voice actress for adult games. Voice acting is both a hobby and a profitable career, and she steadily works a day job as a temporary office worker. Mai's boss, Chief Honjo, is an iron-faced man who remains unfazed no matter what. Even when she teases him with, "I want to see this stiff guy get all worked up from my voice!", Chief Honjo doesn't budge. It's starting to make her lose confidence both as a woman and as a voice actress... And so, the two of them unexpectedly start a bittersweet, secret office romance!? And despite Chief Honjo's cold manner of speech, he's amazing at sex... He's so good at it that he makes her cum just by touching her through her underwear! -- But what would happen if her work in erotic games were discovered?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: えっちな声のオシゴトは堅物上司にも秘密です ～うっかり挑発したら溺愛がはじまりました!?～
title.romaji: Ecchi na Koe no Oshigoto wa Katabutsu Joushi mo Himitsu desu: Ukkari Chouhatsu Shitara Dekiai ga Hajimarimashita!?

204942.description:
Plain Jane Megan Schumacher was the most dependable person on Danbury Way, the sleek suburban cul-de-sac where she lived over her sister's garage. Certainly not the kind of girl who would rock anyone's boat—until she fell for the (barely) ex-husband of her best friend and neighbor!

Greg Banning planned to hire Megan to redo his marketing plan, but he counted the minutes until each of their meetings. As their romance heated up, Greg realized she was everything he wanted in a woman, and his thoughts began straying to marriage. But would their new love spell happiness for both of them—or would the scandal tear them apart?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 真夜中すぎのシンデレラ

204943.description:
When Do-Hui, an orphaned girl, is searching for her missing mother, she meets Si-Hyun, a merman. Si-Hyun promises to help Do-Hui find her mother, and in return, Do-Hui needs to help Si-Hyun find her true love to become fully human. However, strange things begin to happen around Do-Hui. Is her mother's disappearance related to Si-Hyun's appearance?

(Source: WEBTOON, translated)
synonyms: ลำธารแห่งเหล่าเงือก

204944.description:
Lacey was unilaterally terminated from her marriage by Lewis after only one year. After he left, the daughter in her stomach became the center of her heart and all of her love. Nineteen years later, Lacey reunites with him on a relief mission for an incurable disease. Lewis's voice hurts stubbornly... But just by listening to it, it was as if time has been rewound, his smell and the feel of his skin coming back vividly. When he notices his daughter, he mutters bitterly, "I hoped it wasn't my child." He confesses a secret he never intended to tell in his entire life...

(Source: Harlequin, translated)

204945.description:
What if the people living next door were the real danger? From the friendly neighborhood auntie to a delinquent, from a refined upper class elderly man to a suspicious conspiracy YouTuber, anyone living in the same apartment complex could be next. A deadly game begins within the community association, where neighbors turn into targets and ordinary life collapses into paranoia and fear.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 隣人、ヤっちゃいますか？

204946.description:
"Let's get married. We'll fly to Vegas tomorrow." Caleb, third son of the well-known Bravo family in Texas, has employed Irina as his live-in housekeeper for two years. Even if he brings women home without warning or sits around the house naked, she never bats an eye. Caleb can't live without her. But now immigration is threatening to have her deported from America. Caleb proposes a fake marriage to get her a green card, but her response is that she can't have sex with him!

(Source: Renta!)

204947.description:
Disillusioned by the end of his last relationship and tired of his job, Brett returned to his hometown of Sydney to rest his heart and body. But a woman named Joanna had moved into his family's house as a house-sitter. The moment he laid eyes on this beautiful, intriguing woman, he fell deeply in love. However, because of her difficult family past, he decides he ought to protect her rather than pursue her. Not realizing the decision Brett's made, Joanna repeatedly expresses her interest in him. Eventually Brett's self-control will snap, and then he'll find out whether he can be the man Joanna really needs.

(Source: Renta!)

204948.description:
After the better part of a year, Declan had shown up again. The last time Arizona saw him was at her husband's funeral. And he'd only shown up then because he was after her late husband's money. He'd proposed to her back then, thinking she was vulnerable and would agree, but Arizona rejected his offer. Now he says he has news for her...and she must accept his hand in marriage or she will face the consequences!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 予告どおりのプロポーズ

204950.description:
Lisa works at an animal hospital and loves horses more than anything else. Although she shows no interest in marriage, she does find herself interested in veterinarian Nick. Thinking he would be an ideal candidate, she asks him to give her a child. Sadly, he refuses. But Lisa isn't giving up. Around the same time, Nick's twin brother, Neal, suggests they switch places to shake things up. This means Nick would move to New York and live as a popular TV host for a while, and Neal would take his place at the animal hospital. So when Neal switches with Nick, he's unaware of Lisa's baby agenda...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 雨と幸せを連れてきて

204951.description:
My life was laid out peaceful and predictable before me...so how did I end up here?

Mercy has a quiet, unassuming life in the small English village where she was born. Engaged to a frugal yet polite man, she believes that her peaceful life will continue from here on out...that is, until her best friend returns from London and turns everyone on their head! Her friend's wedding is an extravagant affair, very different from anything Mercy has ever known. But then the bride goes into a panic when a handsome man with cold eyes appears. She says that this man, Croft, is here to ruin the wedding. Rushing to her friend's rescue, Mercy tries to distract the man...and ends up ruining her own life instead!

(Source: Harlequin)

204952.description:
A world where alternative genders exist: Alpha, Beta, and Omega. Koyama Rio has lived as a Beta for 25 years. When she finds out she's actually an Omega and confesses to her boyfriend, she is brutally dumped. When she goes into heat, a state unique to Omegas, she is rescued from a dire situation by a complete stranger, the finest Alpha, Shinonome Sena.

But Rio's body responds to Sena, and her throbbing becomes even more intense...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 御曹司と契約オメガ～いけずに甘く嚙まれたい～
title.romaji: Onzoushi to Keiyaku Omega: Ikezu ni Amaku Kamaretai

204953.description:
After a long life with a loving human family, tabby cat Fuuta has passed into the afterlife—but he is not as far from his owner Michiru as it seems. Slight openings bridge the divide between the lands of the living and the dead, and they can be traversed.

Eager to see Michiru again, Fuuta interviews for a position at Café Pont, a café that exists in the liminal space between the two worlds, known for its unique message delivery service: Customers leave requests with the name of the person they wish to meet, and a messenger cat is assigned to arrange the “meeting.” But these encounters cannot happen directly. The cats can only deliver the soul of the desired target by temporarily implanting it into an appropriate third party who then may relay the message in careful words.

If Fuuta doesn’t maintain plausible deniability, he could cause panic amongst the living, or worse: he could upset the balance of the universe itself. It is a weighty task for an old tabby cat, but Fuuta is up for the challenge. After all, the job offers a special reward: the right to see Michiru. And he’ll do anything to reunite with his family again.

(Source: Penguin Random House)
synonyms: Message Cat is in the Cafe

title.native: 伝言猫がカフェにいます
title.romaji: Dengon Neko ga Cafe ni Imasu

204954.description:
Sophia, the daughter of the Earl of Yardley, has always been different than her social peers. Much to the concern of her parents and peers, Sophia would rather give up her noble lineage and marry a man she loves instead of an empty-headed aristocrat. Then one day, Ben, the Duke of Sharnbrook, saves her from danger. Ben is charmed by her immediately and sets out to try to win her hand. However, he soon finds that Sophia has a distaste for aristocratic men, so he hatches a plan to pose as a groom and find work in her household. The two soon grow close, but Ben's false identity, not to mention the interest of other suiters, soon puts their relationship and Ben in danger.

(Source: Renta!)

204955.description:
Sophie always had a crush on her handsome boss, Max, but he is a playboy and devoted to the single life. One day a messenger from the beautiful country of Chantaine comes to inform Max that his father, the king of Chantaine, has died. Sophie is shocked to know her boss was actually a prince all along and realizes she must give up on her love and make a clean break. She tries to quit her job, but Max insists he needs her, whisking her away with him to the royal palace. How will Sophie be able to cure herself of her feelings for Max now?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ボスが突然、プリンスに

204956.description:
Ellie goes to see her family in Capri to celebrate her stepbrother Luke's engagement...but what the rest of the family doesn't know is that Luke is also her ex! It's hard to keep her spirits up, hanging out at the resort alone. Ellie is afraid Luke will think she's not over him, and when no one is looking, Luke keeps hitting on her. Ellie is in a tough spot, so in order to deter Luke, she pretends to be dating her other stepbrother, Jack, even though she can't stand him! But soon their pretend kisses become real, and being with Jack makes her heart pound. What on earth is she feeling for him?

(Source: Renta!)

204957.description:
Ginny is depressed after her beloved stepfather passes away, but her mother and sister are more concerned with their inheritances and eagerly look forward to the reading of his will. When the time finally comes, everything is left to his son, Andre, whom he kept hidden! Ginny's mother assumed that she would inherit everything, and her sister had been planning an extravagant wedding with his money. They threaten Andre, saying the will isn't valid, but he stands firm. And then he directs his appraising gaze to Ginny...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 運命をこの身に宿して
title.romaji: Unmei wo Kono Mi ni Yadoshite

204958.description:
There's a reason Keira had decided to never fall in love with anyone. But when she visited India, she couldn't resist the kiss of a handsome stranger...she'd never see him again after all. But when she met her client the next day, she was speechless-it was the very man who'd kissed her. His name was Jay and he belonged to the prestigious family of the maharaja. It was certainly going to be hard for Keira to reestablish her professional image after that kiss. Once they go to Jay's palace, it became clear that he'd gotten entirely the wrong idea about her. Now what will she do?

(Source: Renta!)

204959.description:
Merry, a server, was in desperate need of money. One day out of the blue, Peter, one of her customers, asked her to pretend to be his girlfriend over the Thanksgiving holiday. He seemed serious and the money would certainly help, so Merry accepted his proposal. When they went to visit his family, his sweet mother welcomed Merry with open arms. She believed that Merry and her son were going to get married. Merry was concerned that Peter's mother was getting too excited about their fake relationship. But she was more concerned about how Peter and his son didn't seem to get along. Perhaps there was a way Merry could help Peter and his family...

(Source: Renta!)

204960.description:
Veterinarian Nick, who lost his beloved wife in July, becomes depressed as summer approaches, so his twin brother, Neal, the star of a popular TV show, proposes that they change places for the summer. Living his brother's playboy life in the city is good for a change, but things get complicated when he and sexy costar, Colleen, kiss. Nick finds her intoxicating, and it's clear that Colleen is interested in him, too, but is it Nick she's falling for or his brother?

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Kokoro no Ame ga Agaru Toki

204961.description:
Calli, a busy patissier, finally takes a long vacation and goes to Gallinas Canyon in New Mexico. But her vacation starts badly when a drunkard hits on her at a bar. He keeps bothering her until a man named Gabriel intervenes. He seems dependable, but there's still something about him that makes her nervous. Still, having no one to turn to, she asks him to show her around. She soon starts falling for him, even believing it was fate that he was there to save her, but she can't quite get close to him. Gabriel, on the other hand, has his own reasons for saving her...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 明治文化編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Meiji Bunka-hen

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 幕末奔流編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Bakumatsu Honryuu-hen

204964.description: Note: Winner of the 6th Analogue Jump Rookie award

204965.description:
When Samarah was six years old, her father's country, Jharrel, and the neighboring country, Khadra, were in conflict, and her father died as a result. Samarah and her mother escaped, but her mother died en route, leaving her daughter without parents. Sixteen years later, twenty-two-year-old Samarah sneaked into the Khadra palace, intending to kill Sheikh Ferran, but she was captured immediately. Unsure of what would happen next, she's caught off guard by Ferran's plan for her-he intends to introduce her to the world as his fiancee!

(Source: Renta!)

204966.description:
Clara has worked for her boss, the smart and handsome Zack, for seven years, but she only realized she was in love with him when he announced he was engaged. She did her best to suppress her feelings for him and help him get ready for the wedding, but when the bride didn't show, it was called off. Yet Zack doesn't seem particularly upset. He says the marriage was just a business tactic. Clara is already perplexed, but then Zack says something even more unexpected. He asks her to go on the honeymoon with him in his bride's place!

(Source: Renta!)

204967.description:
After being left at the altar, Susanna went from happy bride to old maid. In order to escape the shame, she ended up working as a lady's companion. Just as she was on the brink of losing her position, she was suddenly pushed into a carriage. She'd been kidnapped! It seems Sir Ben Wolfe, a wealthy man returning from India, has mistaken her for her mistress. But Susanna's still no closer to understanding why he wants to kidnap anyone.

(Source: Renta!)

204968.description:
Cate, a single working mother raising her son, was astonished by the customer who appeared before her-the fifth baron of Wyndham, Julian Ashton Carlisle...her first love. His unforgettably beautiful blue eyes brought back all the memories of Cate's once-in-a-lifetime romance. But her inability to defy his mother, who'd opposed their relationship due to their different social statuses, caused their relationship to be short-lived. She couldn't believe that they were meeting again, and she feared he would find out about the son she had kept hidden from him...

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Uso to Himitsu to Shiroi Bara

204969.description:
Abby was looking forward to her break-she was planning to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city and go to a cottage on a small island that she'd inherited from her great-uncle. But when she arrived, she found a man and his son already living there! When she tells them that they're trespassing, he laughs at her. There was some kind of a mix-up, and Abby's great-aunt leased the place to them for six weeks. If she tries to kick him out, he'll sue for breach of contract! She has no choice but to share the place with them for two weeks until the boat comes to pick them up...

(Source: Renta!)

204970.description:
Dani grew up in America, but when her marriage failed she had to return to her family in Oman, where she lives under her father's watchful eye. Her greatest joy now is sneaking out to the used bookstore. One day, she meets a man there who takes her breath away, a kind, charismatic entrepreneur named Quasar. They begin seeing each other in secret, but Dani is crushed when she learns that their families are enemies. Dani's father sees everything in black-and-white, and she can't bear to betray him. Is there a future for Dani and Quasar?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 砂漠で見つけた至上の愛
title.romaji: Sabaku de Mitsuketa Shijou no Ai

204971.description:
"Dio, my shackle that binds me..."

It all started when Lucy's father arranged her marriage with Dio. Despite it being a political marriage, the two were in love... Lucy was hopeful for her romantic marriage until the night of their wedding, when she finds out that Dio proposed to her solely to get revenge on her father. After her shock, she decides to act as a perfect wife in front of him. Since then, the two became a couple for show. But now Lucy has reached her limit and pleads for divorce when Dio suggests their first and last honeymoon...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ギャラクシーぷーちゃん 宇宙のはじっこでこんにちは
title.romaji: Galaxy Poo-chan: Uchuu no Hajikko de Konnichiwa

204973.description:
Kim Seojoon, a freshman college student leading a normal daily life, awoke one day to find himself transported into a fantasy world straight out of a webtoon or web novel or something like that. As he began to get excited about potentially having the role of a male lead character, a shocking event unfolded before his eyes—a murder of an imperial family. Consequently, Kim Seojoon found himself imprisoned in the world's prison, Gehenna. Will he be able to navigate the treacherous paths of this unfamiliar world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

204974.description:
The predator of predators has awakened! In life, Bongsu was a serial killer who exclusively hunted murderers and violent criminals. After being gunned down by the police, his dying wish comes true: rebirth inside his favorite game, the brutally graphic world of Murim Online. Armed with a status window only he can see, Bongsu discovers that every kill earns him experience points—and the stronger the prey, the greater the reward. In a world overflowing with ruthless, corrupt martial artists, Bongsu has found the perfect hunting ground. His bloody journey toward the top begins.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: Faran, the Knight Princess of Salvation

title.native: 救世の騎士姫 ファラン

204976.description: A vengeful spirit from a thousand years ago appears in the present world!? A horror comedy is born!

204977.description:
When high school boy Junta Harukawa was attacked and killed by a random assailant, he became a lingering ghost with the regret of never having had a girlfriend, Junta takes an interest in his classmate Onodera, who visits his grave every day.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Note: Originally published in Dengeki Daioh G vol. 128, Feb. 2026 issue.

204978.description:
The night I spent with him was like a dream... I had no idea he was a sheikh!

As soon as she arrives in Hong Kong, Tiffany is mugged, losing her wallet and her passport. She picks up some work at a bar in order to make enough money to pay for her first night in a hotel, where she meets a man named Rafiq. He's so mysterious it's as if he's from another world. Tiffany is instantly drawn to him, and they spend the night together. But the next morning Rafiq concludes that Tiffany was only interested in blackmailing him. Tiffany has never been so hurt by a rejection! Then, three months later, she must walk back into his life with the news that she's pregnant!

(Source: SB Creative Corp.)

title.native: シークに愛された一夜

204979.description:
Akari is good at her job, beautiful, and her sense of style is beyond compare... but she has a secret. She's almost 30 and she's still a virgin! One fateful day, a new department chief takes over -- the handsome Shinomiya. "You're my subordinate now, which means from today, you have to do what I say." Shinomiya is a condescending bully and he and Akari clash from day one. Akari finds herself drinking her worries away at his welcome party and before she knows what hit her she's completely smashed. She wakes up the next day to find -- Shinomiya emerging from her bathroom half naked?!?! Thus begins Akari's comedic office romance with her callous new boss!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

204980.description:
The story of a girl who finds a shadow someone had (literally) dropped.

Note: First published in the 1969 April issue of COM

204981.description:
They met at the hospital when the youngest daughter of the Marchetti family gave birth. The moment the nurse, Liz, saw Joe Marchetti, she fell for his kind gaze. But she was traumatized by the way her philandering father had always kept her family in a state of near collapse, so she had no expectations of romance from handsome men. A year later, Joe applied for a volunteer program at the hospital, but what did this handsome man hope to get out of it? Liz started working with him-and opening her heart to him-when she saw his diligence and honesty.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: あなたの腕で眠らせて

204982.description:
Intelligent, unflappable Brianna was secretary to Sakis, the Greek shipping tycoon. After being abandoned by her mother, betrayed by her lover and sent to prison, she'd changed her name and vowed never to open her heart to anyone again. Not even her boss, despite her feelings for him. Then a company tanker got in an accident and the two of them ended up flying to the Republic of the Congo. But with only one room left in the hotel, they'll have to share it!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: What the Greek's Money Can't Buy

204983.description:
When actress Blair visits a ranch in Wyoming, she meets cowboy Dillon. When Blair asks him to train her for her next role as a rancher, Dillon doesn't look interested-he has a dark past and pain written on his face. But Blair doesn't mind his scar at all-she finds herself falling for Dillon, who continues to keep his heart shut...no matter how drawn to her he may be.

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Anata no Hoo ni Kiss wo

synonyms: The prince lives in his own world

title.native: 王子が空気読まなすぎる

204985.description:
Jade is a social butterfly who makes regular appearances in the tabloids, but she's in a tight spot! A close family friend has passed away and stipulated in his will that his son Nic will only inherit a large share of his estate if he and Jade marry. In the meantime, Jade's father has also cut her off from her family's trust funds, and if she marries Nic, she'll also get some of the inheritance... But Jade can't forget the way Nic treated her ten years ago. And besides, it seems like he still can't stand her. Yet she has a secret reason why she can't live on her own...so she has no choice but to marry him!

(Source: Renta!)

204986.description:
One night Caleb saved Sage from a sexual assault, and after such a harrowing near miss, she felt a deep attraction to him. He escorted her home, and they came together naturally. However, the next morning Caleb mistook her male roommate for her boyfriend and left, angry that Sage had brought him home as a one-night stand. The only thing he left behind was the small life growing inside of Sage. Now, three months later, Sage is in trouble-accused of being a gold digger. And that's when she meets capable lawyer Caleb Wilde for the second time!

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Nemurenu Yoru to Hitori no Asa

204987.description:
Every time Terri breaks up with somebody, she seeks the comfort of the chocolates her best friend Nic makes. Though she's now given up on marriage before the age of thirty, she still has one goal: to become a mother! But Nic is completely against the idea of her using a sperm bank. Instead he proposes an even more far-fetched idea: Nic thinks he would be the perfect man to become the father of Terri's child! As the plan to conceive a child together develops further, Terri becomes conflicted about her growing feelings for Nic and worried she might lose their lifelong friendship.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 花嫁は一千万ドル I

title.native: 本気のキスは契約違反
title.romaji: Honki no Kiss wa Keiyaku Ihan

204988.description:
"If it's a rich man you're after, perhaps I might suffice?" Proud Cristina's pride is torn to shreds by the scorn dripping from her ex-lover's proposal. Her family business is on the brink of bankruptcy, and her last chance to save it has come in the form of a party held by the Brazilian elite. She's there to find an investor, but no one's biting. No one, that is, except for Anton Scott-Lee-the president of one of the biggest banks in the world and Cristina's ex. He's held a grudge ever since they broke up. Now that she's come crawling back, he has his revenge. But he doesn't know the true reason Cristina tore his heart to shreds six years ago...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: ラミレス家の花嫁 II

title.romaji: Futatsu no Kao wo Motsu Koibito

204989.description:
Elderly Yuriko has memories of Mee-chan, a mysterious friend from long ago. Mee-chan would appear at crucial turning points in Yuriko's life, always treating her with warmth and kindness. Yet, no matter how many years passed, Mee-chan never aged...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

204990.description:
A corporate drama story centering on a resignation agent who will either open up freedom or a new hell to their clients.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: ヤメタイ！～あなたのリセット、代行します～
title.romaji: Yametai!: Anata no Reset, Daikou Shimasu

204991.description:
Johara was stunned when she read the article. Shortly after returning to his desert kingdom after studying abroad, Prince Shaheen was already preparing for marriage! Johara has been in love with him ever since Shaheen saved her life when she was young. She even swore that she would dedicate her life to him. Although she moved to Paris after her parents divorced, Shaheen has never left her mind. She knew the daughter of a servant could never become the prince's bride, but she could at least go and see the prince one last time...even if it was just a glance. And so Johara slipped her way into Shaheen's farewell party, unaware of the disaster that their reunion would bring.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Kono Mi wo Sheikh ni Sasagete - Zohayd no Houseki

title.english: To Tame a Sheikh Pride of Zohayd
title.native: この身をシークに捧げて
title.romaji: Kono Mi wo Sheikh ni Sasagete

204992.description:
Ever since losing her parents in a tragic accident, Eden's been spending her days with her stepbrother, Thomas, in a run-down, hole-in-the-wall apartment in London. It's there that she meets Sterne Parnell, Thomas's boss and the CEO of a major design firm, who's just shown up at her front door dressed as dashingly as can be. He's convinced that Thomas is trying to elope with Sterne's ward, Carmilla, who's been in his care ever since her father died of a heart attack...and from the contempt in his eyes, it's clear he thinks Eden is Thomas's partner in crime!

(Source: Renta!)

204993.description:
Ally was speechless when she saw her husband, Finn, again after two months apart. They'd fallen in love and eloped in the blink of an eye, but their marriage didn't last. The successor to one of the biggest jewelry companies in the world, he took her to his hometown right after they got married. But his disposition soon turned stony, and he devoted all his time to his work, never giving his lonely wife a second thought. Deeply hurt, she left his house out of desperation. But now Finn is back in Ally's life and looking at her with passionate eyes. What could have led to such a change?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 記憶なき富豪への贈り物

204995.description:
The day before her wedding, Stefanie finds out her fiance eloped with her best friend, Noelle. In shock, she quits her job and leaves her hometown. Then one day, she runs into Noelle's ex-fiance. Needing a wife for his job, he surprises Stefanie by asking her to marry him. Despite some hesitation, she accepts his offer. His kindness helps her begin to heal her broken heart, even as she realizes that their makeshift marriage is more than a little confusing.

(Source: Renta!)

204996.description:
Two years ago, Rachel happened to walk in on her husband, Ben, and their babysitter in bed together. And Ben had the temerity to claim he hadn't cheated on her! Since then, they've been living separately, but now Rachel's boyfriend has asked her to move in together. It seems like it's time for Rachel to move on, so she asked Ben for a divorce. She wants to marry Simon and settle down for the sake of her young daughter, but Ben's refusing her request!

(Source: Renta!)

204997.description:
Tomboy Katie Malloy was neighbor to Sean Fitzpatrick and his brothers...and effectively an adopted member of their family. Kate and Sean have spent the past two decades as best friends, supporting one another in their various relationships and life goals. Now, as they near their thirties, Sean is a successful private investigator in business with his brothers. And Katie? She wants to have a child, and she has a list of potential fathers for Sean to investigate. While Sean will investigate three potential baby daddies, he just has to know whose were the other two names that Katie struck from her list. One was his brother with whom she broke things off. The other was Sean himself. Would Sean want to be the father of Katie's child? Katie's been like a sister to him all these years, but maybe their friendship has been hiding something more...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Story of Me Drowning With My Ex-Boyfriend

204999.description:
When Carol turned twenty years old, Damon, a handsome lawyer brimming with mature charm, appeared in front of her. He told her that her grandfather had passed away and a huge inheritance was left to her. From that day, Carol's life changed completely-she had become a young heiress. Damon helped Carol, who was in utter confusion. She's been attracted to him since the day they met and her feelings for him are only growing stronger. She assumed hers was an unrequited love until he stole a kiss...

(Source: Renta!)
